dishes.name: Iraqi Fava Beans with Egg on Bread
dishes.concept: Dried broad beans soaked overnight and simmered with cumin until tender, spooned with their broth over torn whole-wheat bread and topped with a poached egg, with a measured spoon of olive oil instead of the traditional ghee (canned fava beans are too salty for a 700 mg breakfast).

dishes.name: Iraqi Eggs with Minced Beef and Tomato
dishes.concept: Extra-lean minced beef browned with onion, tomato and green pepper, finished with eggs stirred through in the pan and served with whole-wheat bread and fresh herbs; 95% lean beef keeps the saturated fat of meat plus egg in range.

dishes.name: Iraqi Chickpeas in Cumin Broth
dishes.concept: The Baghdad winter street breakfast: chickpeas simmered in a light onion and cumin broth, finished with lemon, black pepper and a small drizzle of olive oil.

dishes.name: Iraqi Wheat and Chicken Porridge
dishes.concept: Whole wheat berries slow-cooked with chicken breast until thick and creamy, seasoned with cinnamon and measured salt instead of the usual ghee and sugar topping.

dishes.name: Kurdish Bread, Cheese and Herb Breakfast Plate
dishes.concept: The everyday Kurdish breakfast spread of whole-wheat flatbread, a big handful of fresh herbs, cucumber, tomato and a few walnuts, with only a small piece of white cheese (about 15 g) and a bowl of thick yogurt; the yogurt, not more cheese, supplies the protein, keeping sodium and saturated fat in range.

dishes.name: Persian Lentil Breakfast Stew
dishes.concept: Green lentils simmered with onion, turmeric and a little potato until thick, finished with cumin and lemon; a traditional Persian breakfast that needs no bread.

dishes.name: Whole-Wheat Za'atar Manakish with Salad
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat flatbread baked with a thin za'atar and olive-oil topping, served with tomato, cucumber and mint to fold inside; whole-wheat dough supplies the protein and fiber.

dishes.name: Turkish Poached Eggs on Garlic Yogurt
dishes.concept: Poached eggs on thick garlicky nonfat yogurt, drizzled with olive oil warmed with Aleppo pepper instead of butter, with whole-wheat bread for dipping; nonfat yogurt keeps two eggs within the saturated-fat limit.

dishes.name: Chickpea Fatteh with Yogurt
dishes.concept: Oven-toasted whole-wheat pita layered with warm chickpeas and a garlic yogurt-tahini sauce, dusted with cumin and paprika; baked rather than fried bread and no nut topping keep it light.

dishes.name: Turkish Scrambled Eggs with Peppers and Tomato
dishes.concept: The Turkish breakfast pan of green peppers and ripe tomatoes cooked down until jammy, with eggs stirred through until just set and whole-wheat bread for mopping up. A lighter version: a couple of teaspoons of olive oil instead of butter and plenty of vegetables keep saturated fat under 10% of energy.

dishes.name: Warm Chickpeas with Tahini and Lemon
dishes.concept: The Palestinian and Lebanese breakfast of warm whole chickpeas folded into a lemony tahini and garlic sauce, finished with cumin, paprika and a thread of olive oil. Low-sodium chickpeas and a modest spoon of tahini make it a lighter bowl with about 15 g of fiber and 20 g of protein, and no bread keeps it gluten-free.

dishes.name: Red Lentil, Bulgur and Mint Soup
dishes.concept: The red lentil and bulgur soup from Gaziantep in south-east Turkey, where it is eaten for breakfast, seasoned with tomato and pepper paste and finished with dried mint sizzled in olive oil. Olive oil instead of butter and measured pepper paste keep it light, with about 17 g of protein and 9 g of fiber per bowl.

dishes.name: Persian Street-Style Spiced Beans
dishes.concept: The winter street breakfast of Tehran: red beans simmered with onion and turmeric until soft and soupy, then sharpened with lemon and black pepper. Low-sodium canned beans make a quick, lighter version with no added fat and about 13 g of fiber per bowl.

dishes.name: Labneh and Za'atar Breakfast Plate
dishes.concept: The Levantine breakfast table on one plate: thick strained yogurt swirled with olive oil and za'atar, with cucumber, tomato, mint, a few olives and warm whole-wheat pita. A lighter version made with nonfat strained yogurt, so it carries over 25 g of protein with very little saturated fat.

dishes.name: Spinach and Eggs with Garlic Yogurt
dishes.concept: A Turkish home breakfast of wilted spinach and onion with eggs cooked in hollows on top, served with cool garlic yogurt and a dusting of Aleppo pepper. A lighter version with nonfat yogurt and a little olive oil instead of butter: about 40 g of protein, no bread, and gluten-free.

dishes.name: Persian Potato Kuku
dishes.concept: A thick Persian potato and egg cake scented with turmeric and spring onion, pan-cooked until golden on both sides and served in wedges with fresh tomato. This lighter version uses no flour and just a measured spoon of olive oil instead of the usual shallow-frying.

dishes.name: Turkish Spinach and White Cheese Flatbread
dishes.concept: Thin hand-rolled whole-wheat flatbreads folded around spinach, onion and crumbled white cheese and cooked on a dry griddle, as at Turkish village markets. A lighter version: whole-wheat dough, a modest amount of cheese and only a light brush of olive oil instead of butter, for about 10 g of fiber per gözleme.

dishes.name: Persian Rose and Cardamom Rice Pudding
dishes.concept: A silky warm pudding of rice flour cooked in milk and scented with rosewater and cardamom, a classic Persian breakfast and pre-dawn meal in Ramadan. This lighter version uses 1% milk and a measured spoon of sugar, and chopped dates and pomegranate seeds replace the usual pistachios, for about 13 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Turkish Potato and Egg Skillet
dishes.concept: A Turkish home breakfast of small potato cubes cooked soft and golden with onion and green pepper, with eggs stirred through until just set and finished with parsley and pul biber, served with sliced tomato. A lighter version with a spoon of olive oil instead of butter and potatoes instead of bread: gluten-free, with about 15 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Iraqi Red Lentil Soup
dishes.concept: Red lentils simmered with onion, carrot, cumin and turmeric, blended smooth and finished with lemon; sold as a winter street breakfast across Iraq, and a generous bowl is a full meal with no cream or butter.

dishes.name: Kurdish Bulgur Pilaf with Chickpeas and Tomato
dishes.concept: Coarse bulgur cooked Kurdish-style with onion, tomato paste and chickpeas in one pot, served with a cucumber and herb salad; whole grain and legumes make it filling.

dishes.name: Kurdish Leek and Herb Stuffed Flatbread
dishes.concept: The Sulaymaniyah griddle bread: thin whole-wheat dough folded around a filling of leeks, spring onions and herbs and cooked on a dry pan with a light brush of oil.

dishes.name: Kurdish Yogurt Soup with Rice and Chickpeas
dishes.concept: Warm yogurt soup with rice, chickpeas and fresh herbs, stabilized with a spoon of rice flour instead of egg and finished with dried mint; a comforting Erbil classic.

dishes.name: Kurdish Mung Bean and Rice Soup
dishes.concept: Whole mung beans simmered with a little rice, onion, tomato and dried mint into a thick Kurdish winter soup; high in fiber and protein with only a spoon of oil.

dishes.name: Iraqi Dill Rice with Fava Beans and Chicken
dishes.concept: Basmati rice steamed with fava beans, fresh dill and baharat, served with skinless chicken simmered in its own broth; the beans stretch the rice into a high-fiber plate.

dishes.name: Iraqi Rice Kubba in Sour Turnip Soup
dishes.concept: Rice-dough kubba stuffed with lean minced beef, simmered (never fried) in a lemony broth of turnips, beetroot, chard and chickpeas.

dishes.name: Iraqi Dolma with Vine Leaves and Stuffed Vegetables
dishes.concept: Onions, peppers, zucchini and vine leaves stuffed with rice, lean minced lamb leg, herbs and tomato, simmered in a sour pomegranate-lemon broth; fresh or frozen vine leaves instead of brined jarred ones (far too salty), and more vegetables and less meat than usual.
keyIngredients: grape leaves, fresh or frozen, raw

dishes.name: Iraqi Lamb and Split Chickpea Stew
dishes.concept: The Karbala and Najaf stew of minced lean lamb leg and split chickpeas cooked down with tomato, dried lime and warm spices, served over basmati rice; lean leg meat rather than fatty ready-minced lamb keeps saturated fat in range.

dishes.name: Kurdish Herb Beef Patties with Bulgur Salad
dishes.concept: Lean minced beef mixed with parsley, onion and spices, shaped into flat patties and pan-seared with a teaspoon of oil, served with whole-wheat flatbread and a sumac onion, tomato and cucumber salad.

dishes.name: Basra Fish with Spiced Rice
dishes.concept: Southern Iraqi layered fish and rice: white fish pan-seared in a little oil instead of deep-fried, set over basmati rice cooked with onion, turmeric, loomi and baharat.
keyIngredients: white fish fillet (cod or tilapia), raw

dishes.name: Iraqi Pea and Chicken Stew with Rice
dishes.concept: Green peas and diced chicken breast simmered in a tomato and baharat sauce, served with basmati rice; the everyday Iraqi maraq made with lean meat and plenty of peas.

dishes.name: Lentils and Rice with Caramelized Onions
dishes.concept: Brown lentils and rice cooked together with cumin and topped with onions slowly caramelized in a measured spoon of olive oil (not fried), served with a tomato-cucumber salad.

dishes.name: Red Lentil and Bulgur Patties in Lettuce
dishes.concept: Red lentils cooked until soft, kneaded with fine bulgur, pepper paste, spring onion and parsley, shaped by hand and eaten in lettuce leaves with lemon; no frying at all.

dishes.name: Baked Falafel Bowl with Tahini
dishes.concept: Falafel of soaked dried chickpeas, herbs and spices baked on an oiled tray instead of deep-fried, served over a chopped salad with lemon-tahini sauce.

dishes.name: Persian Herb Frittata
dishes.concept: A thick frittata that is mostly herbs (parsley, coriander, dill, chives) bound with eggs, studded with walnuts and barberries and cooked with little oil, served with whole-wheat lavash and a Shirazi salad; the bread balances the eggs so saturated fat stays in range.

dishes.name: Freekeh Salad with Chickpeas, Herbs and Feta
dishes.concept: Smoky cracked freekeh tossed with chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, mint and parsley in a lemon-sumac dressing, with a small crumble of feta; a whole-grain salad that works as a full meal.

dishes.name: Turkish White Bean Salad with Tuna
dishes.concept: White beans, sliced red onion, tomato and parsley dressed with lemon, sumac and olive oil, topped with water-packed tuna; a no-cook high-protein salad.

dishes.name: Grilled Mackerel Sandwich with Onion Salad
dishes.concept: Istanbul's waterfront favorite: mackerel fillets grilled in a dry pan and tucked into whole-wheat bread with lettuce, sumac onions and tomato, finished with lemon.

dishes.name: Sumac Chicken with Onions on Whole-Wheat Flatbread
dishes.concept: Palestinian roast chicken with plenty of sumac-braised onions, served on whole-wheat taboon-style bread with a fraction of the usual oil and no fried pine nuts.

dishes.name: Turkish Thin Flatbread with Spiced Beef
dishes.concept: Thin whole-wheat rounds spread with lean minced beef, tomato, pepper and parsley, baked hot and rolled up with lemon, parsley and a crunchy salad.

dishes.name: Persian Green Bean Rice with Beef
dishes.concept: Basmati rice layered and steamed with green beans and lean beef cooked in tomato, cinnamon and turmeric; more beans and less rice than the classic.

dishes.name: Lighter Iraqi Quzi with Lamb and Spiced Rice
dishes.concept: The festive Iraqi platter scaled for every day: lean lamb leg slow-braised with baharat and loomi over basmati rice with peas and carrots, topped with a few toasted almonds and raisins.

dishes.name: Iraqi Vegetable and Chickpea Biryani
dishes.concept: A lighter meatless take on Iraqi biryani: basmati rice with toasted vermicelli, chickpeas, peas, carrots and oven-roasted potato cubes, perfumed with biryani spices and cooked with measured oil instead of ghee.

dishes.name: Baked Eggplant and Cauliflower Maqluba
dishes.concept: The upside-down rice pot layered with oven-roasted (not fried) eggplant and cauliflower, chickpeas and tomato, flipped at the table and served with cucumber-yogurt salad.

dishes.name: Masgouf-Style Baked Fish
dishes.concept: Baghdad's riverside fish reworked for the oven: fillets brushed with turmeric and tamarind, roasted under a topping of tomato and onion and served, as in Baghdad, with whole-wheat flatbread and a chopped salad.

dishes.name: Iraqi Eggplant and Meatball Casserole
dishes.concept: Layers of oven-roasted eggplant (not fried), potato, onion, tomato and small lean-beef meatballs baked in a tangy tomato sauce; served with a little rice.

dishes.name: Baked Tray Kubba
dishes.concept: A bulgur and lean-beef shell pressed into a tray around a spiced onion and minced-meat filling, scored and baked with a brush of oil rather than fried as individual kubba.

dishes.name: Iraqi Okra and Lamb Stew
dishes.concept: Baby okra and cubes of lean lamb simmered in a garlicky tomato broth soured with lemon, served with basmati rice; the okra is added whole, not fried first.

dishes.name: Iraqi Chicken Tashreeb with Chickpeas
dishes.concept: Chicken simmered with chickpeas, onion, loomi and turmeric, the broth ladled over torn whole-wheat flatbread; skinless chicken keeps the fat low.

dishes.name: Iraqi Lamb Tikka Skewers
dishes.concept: Lean lamb cubes marinated briefly in onion juice, lemon and black pepper, grilled on skewers with tomatoes and onions and served with sumac salad and whole-wheat flatbread.

dishes.name: Kurdish Rice with White Bean Stew
dishes.concept: The Kurdish household staple: white beans simmered in a tomato and onion stew, spooned over rice, here made without meat and with only a spoon of oil.

dishes.name: Iraqi Spinach Stew with Lamb and Chickpeas
dishes.concept: Spinach wilted into an onion, garlic and coriander base with chickpeas and a squeeze of lemon, served over rice; a meatless version of the Iraqi green stew.

dishes.name: Kurdish Noodle and Lentil Soup
dishes.concept: Brown lentils and whole-wheat noodles simmered in a herby broth with spinach and dried mint, finished with a swirl of mint oil made with a single spoon of oil.

dishes.name: Kurdish Chicken Kebab with Grilled Vegetables and Rice
dishes.concept: Chicken cubes marinated in yogurt, tomato paste, garlic and Aleppo pepper, grilled on skewers the way Erbil and Sulaymaniyah kebab houses do, with charred eggplant, peppers and tomatoes, sumac onions and plain rice. Breast meat and nonfat yogurt keep it lean, with over 40 g protein in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Kurdish Grilled Fish with Sumac Onions and Roast Potatoes
dishes.concept: The lakeside meal of Dukan and Darbandikhan: carp fillets rubbed with garlic, turmeric and lemon and grilled until the skin crisps, served with a tomato, sumac onion and parsley salad. Oven-roasted potato wedges stand in for the usual fried potatoes, keeping it around 450 kcal with 34 g protein.

dishes.name: Kurdish Bulgur and Green Lentil Pilaf with Caramelized Onions
dishes.concept: Coarse bulgur cooked in one pot with green lentils, tomato paste and cumin, heaped with slow-browned onions and served with a lemony tomato and cucumber salad; a village staple across Kurdistan. Two whole foods together give about 21 g plant protein and 15 g fiber per plate.

dishes.name: Kurdish Chickpea and Spinach Stew with Rice
dishes.concept: An everyday Kurdish home stew: chickpeas simmered in an onion, garlic and tomato base with turmeric and Aleppo pepper, with fresh spinach wilted in and dried mint and lemon to finish, spooned over rice. Low-sodium chickpeas and plenty of greens give over 11 g fiber in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Kurdish Lamb and Eggplant Stew with Sumac and Garlic
dishes.concept: The sour, garlicky stew of Diyarbakır (Amed): lean lamb braised with tomato and pepper, then simmered with eggplant and finished with crushed garlic and sumac, served with rice. Roasting the eggplant instead of frying it, and using lean leg, makes a lighter plate with about 28 g protein and 8 g fiber.

dishes.name: Iraqi Green Bean and Chicken Stew with Rice
dishes.concept: The summer maraq of Baghdad: green beans and chicken simmered in a tomato and baharat sauce soured with a dried lime, served with basmati rice. Lean breast meat stands in for the usual lamb, giving a lighter plate with about 34 g protein and 7 g fiber in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Iraqi Rice and Red Lentils with Tomato Salad
dishes.concept: The soft Baghdadi pot of rice and red lentils cooked together with onion, garlic and cumin, an old Thursday-night and winter supper, served with a sumac tomato and cucumber salad. More lentil than rice gives nearly 20 g plant protein and 10 g fiber in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Iraqi Cauliflower and Chickpea Stew with Rice
dishes.concept: Golden cauliflower simmered in a garlicky tomato and baharat sauce, finished with lemon and served over rice. A lighter, meatless take on the Baghdadi stew: the florets are pan-browned in a little oil instead of deep-fried and chickpeas replace the lamb, for about 13 g fiber in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Iraqi Baked Chicken and Potato Tray
dishes.concept: A Friday family tray from Iraqi home kitchens: skinless chicken thighs baked over potatoes, onions and peppers in a baharat, garlic and tomato sauce, covered with tomato slices so everything steams, then browns. Measured oil and lean thighs keep it around 470 kcal with 36 g protein.

dishes.name: Basra Fish Curry with Tamarind and Rice
dishes.concept: The southern Iraqi fish stew from the port of Basra, where Indian spices met the Gulf: white fish poached in a tomato, onion and curry sauce soured with tamarind and dried lime, served with basmati rice. Poaching instead of frying keeps it light, with about 34 g protein in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Kurdish Chicken and Bulgur Pilaf with Peppers
dishes.concept: A one-pot sawar from Kurdish kitchens: coarse bulgur simmered with chicken, green peppers, tomato and Aleppo pepper until it soaks up every bit of sauce, served with a cucumber, parsley and mint salad. Whole-grain bulgur and lean chicken give about 36 g protein and 12 g fiber per plate.

dishes.name: Persian Saffron Chicken Kebab
dishes.concept: Chicken breast marinated in saffron, lemon, onion and yogurt, grilled on skewers with tomatoes and served with brown basmati rice and a Shirazi salad instead of buttered chelow.

dishes.name: Persian Herb Stew with Lamb and Kidney Beans
dishes.concept: Lean lamb and kidney beans slow-cooked with a mountain of sautéed parsley, coriander, leek and fenugreek and soured with dried limes; the herbs are sautéed in a measured spoon of oil, served with basmati rice.

dishes.name: Baked Kofta with Potatoes in Tahini Sauce
dishes.concept: Lean beef and parsley kofta baked on a tray with sliced potatoes, onions and tomatoes under a thin lemon-tahini sauce, served with a green salad.

dishes.name: Lebanese Spicy Baked Fish
dishes.concept: White fish fillets baked under a Beirut-style topping of coriander, garlic, chili and lemon sautéed in a little olive oil, served with boiled new potatoes and a chopped salad.
keyIngredients: white fish fillet (cod or sea bass), raw

dishes.name: Smoky Eggplant with Tomato and Eggs
dishes.concept: The Caspian dish of charred, mashed eggplant cooked with garlic, tomato and turmeric, with eggs stirred through at the end, served with brown rice (charring the eggplant and the rice take it past 30 minutes).

dishes.name: Turkish Zucchini Fritters with Garlic Yogurt
dishes.concept: Grated, squeezed zucchini with eggs, dill, spring onion and a little whole-wheat flour, pan-seared as thin fritters in measured oil (never deep-fried), with nonfat garlic yogurt and a tomato salad; left without the usual feta so saturated fat stays in range.

dishes.name: Turkish Shepherd's Lamb Sauté with Bulgur Pilaf
dishes.concept: Small cubes of lean lamb leg seared in a measured spoon of olive oil with green peppers, onion and tomato and a little pepper paste, served with coarse bulgur pilaf; a 30-minute pan dish with lean meat and plenty of vegetables.

dishes.name: Turkish Steamed Fish with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Fish fillets gently steamed in a covered pan over sliced potatoes, tomatoes, peppers and onion with lemon and dill; a one-pan dinner with only a spoon of olive oil.
keyIngredients: white fish fillet (sea bass or cod), raw

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken Skewers with Bulgur Pilaf
dishes.concept: Chicken breast marinated in yogurt, tomato and pepper paste, cumin and pul biber, grilled on skewers with green peppers and served with bulgur pilaf and a shepherd's salad with sumac onions. A 30-minute grill plate with over 40 g of protein and 10 g of fiber; nonfat yogurt and a measured spoon of pepper paste keep it lean and low in salt.

dishes.name: Levantine Freekeh with Chicken
dishes.concept: Smoky cracked green wheat simmered in chicken broth with onion and seven-spice and finished with browned chicken, served with a lemony tomato and cucumber salad. A quicker, lighter take on the Palestinian and Lebanese feast dish, with breast meat instead of a whole poached chicken and no fried nut topping, for about 40 g of protein and almost 10 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Persian Herb Rice with Turmeric Fish
dishes.concept: The Nowruz plate of basmati rice packed with parsley, dill, coriander, spring onion and garlic, served with pan-seared turmeric fish, lemon and a Shirazi salad. This quick, lighter version cooks the rice by absorption with a little olive oil instead of steaming it with butter for a tahdig, and sears the fish rather than frying it.

dishes.name: Turkish Chickpea Stew with Bulgur Pilaf
dishes.concept: The Turkish home-cooking staple of chickpeas simmered in a tomato and pepper-paste sauce with onion and green pepper, served next to bulgur pilaf, here made without meat. Low-sodium canned chickpeas make it a 30-minute vegan dinner with about 17 g of protein and 16 g of fiber a plate, seasoned mostly by the pepper paste with very little added salt.

dishes.name: Caspian Broad Bean and Dill Stew with Eggs
dishes.concept: A favourite of Gilan on Iran's Caspian coast: broad beans simmered with plenty of garlic, dill and turmeric, finished with eggs cooked on top and served with plain kateh rice. Frozen broad beans make it a 30-minute vegetarian dinner with about 20 g of protein and 8 g of fiber, cooked in a measured spoon of olive oil instead of the usual generous pour.

dishes.name: Persian Rice with Lentils, Dates and Raisins
dishes.concept: Saffron-scented basmati rice steamed with green lentils and cinnamon and topped with golden onions, raisins and dates, the sweet and savory pilaf of Iranian winter nights. Made vegan and lighter with olive oil instead of butter, it brings about 18 g of protein and 9 g of fiber a plate, sweetened only by the fruit.

dishes.name: Gaziantep Smoky Eggplant Yogurt with Lamb
dishes.concept: The Gaziantep classic: flame-charred eggplant mashed into garlicky yogurt and topped with small cubes of lamb cooked with tomato, green pepper and pepper paste, served with bulgur pilaf. A lighter version with lean leg meat, nonfat strained yogurt and olive oil instead of butter, at about 44 g of protein and 16 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Hummus with Vegetable Sticks
dishes.concept: Chickpeas blended with tahini, lemon, garlic and cumin (a spoon of olive oil, measured salt) served with carrot, cucumber and pepper sticks instead of bread.

dishes.name: Baba Ghanoush with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Oven-charred eggplant mashed with garlic, lemon, tomato, pepper and parsley and a little pomegranate, scooped up with cucumber and radish slices.

dishes.name: Crunchy Roasted Chickpeas with Cumin and Sumac
dishes.concept: Canned chickpeas dried, tossed with a teaspoon of oil, cumin, sumac and a pinch of salt, and roasted for about 35 minutes until crisp; a crunchy high-fiber alternative to salted nuts.

dishes.name: Dates Stuffed with Walnuts
dishes.concept: Iraqi dates with the stone replaced by a walnut half, a portion of three; whole fruit gives the sweetness, so there is no added sugar.

dishes.name: Tabbouleh with Lettuce Leaves
dishes.concept: The Lebanese parsley salad with a little fine bulgur, tomato, mint and spring onion in lemon and a measured spoon of olive oil, scooped up with crisp lettuce leaves; a light, fiber-rich bite with no frying or cheese.

dishes.name: Kurdish Cucumber and Mint Yogurt
dishes.concept: Thick nonfat yogurt stirred with grated cucumber, garlic, dried mint and a little dill, eaten from a bowl with a spoon or with vegetable sticks; nonfat yogurt because low-fat yogurt on its own is over the saturated-fat limit.

dishes.name: Kurdish Minty Yogurt Drink
dishes.concept: Nonfat plain yogurt whisked with cold water, crushed dried mint; the Kurdish summer drink with protein and no sugar, left unsalted because the yogurt already brings about 190 mg of sodium a glass.

dishes.name: Persian Nut and Dried Fruit Mix
dishes.concept: A small portioned bowl of unsalted pistachios, almonds, roasted chickpeas, dried mulberries and raisins, the Nowruz snack without the salted coating.

dishes.name: Iraqi Boiled Turnips with Date Syrup
dishes.concept: The Baghdad winter street snack: whole turnips simmered until tender and sweet, halved and eaten hot with a pinch of salt and a teaspoon of date syrup (dibis) drizzled over; a naturally sweet, very low-fat snack.

dishes.name: Muhammara with Vegetable Sticks
dishes.concept: Aleppo's red pepper and walnut dip made with fresh peppers charred under the grill (jarred roasted peppers are brined and too salty for a snack), cumin, lemon and a teaspoon of pomegranate molasses, without breadcrumbs, served with cucumber and celery sticks.

dishes.name: Baked Spinach Triangles
dishes.concept: Small whole-wheat dough triangles filled with spinach, onion, sumac and lemon and baked, not fried; two pieces make a filling savory snack.

dishes.name: Urfa Spiced Bulgur Bites in Lettuce
dishes.concept: The meatless çiğ köfte of Şanlıurfa: fine bulgur kneaded with hot pepper flakes, tomato and pepper paste, onion and herbs until it holds together, then shaped by hand and wrapped in crisp lettuce with a squeeze of lemon. No cooking, about 180 kcal and 6 g of fiber a serving, and lighter on salt than the street version, with a measured spoon of pepper paste and only a pinch of salt.

dishes.name: Lebanese Spicy Potatoes with Coriander
dishes.concept: The Lebanese mezze of crisp potato cubes tossed with garlic, chili, coriander and lemon. This lighter version pan-roasts the potatoes in a little olive oil instead of deep-frying them, for about 170 kcal a bowl with very little salt.

dishes.name: Warm Chickpeas with Cumin and Lemon
dishes.concept: The Levantine street snack of warm whole chickpeas tossed with garlic, cumin, lemon and a thread of olive oil and eaten from a small bowl with a spoon. Made with chickpeas cooked without salt, a bowl has about 200 kcal, 9 g of protein and 8 g of fiber and very little sodium.

dishes.name: Persian Yogurt with Cucumber, Raisins and Mint
dishes.concept: The Persian summer bowl of thick yogurt stirred with diced cucumber, raisins, dried mint and dill, sweet and savory at once and eaten with a spoon. Nonfat strained yogurt gives over 10 g of protein a bowl, and the usual walnuts are left out so it stays nut-free.

dishes.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait with Pumpkin Seeds
dishes.concept: Layers of plain nonfat Greek yogurt, mixed berries and toasted pumpkin seeds with a dusting of cinnamon; seeds replace sugary granola, and nonfat yogurt keeps saturated fat in range.

dishes.name: Date, Oat and Almond Energy Balls
dishes.concept: No-bake bites of dates, rolled oats, almond butter, cocoa and chia blitzed together and rolled; sweet from whole dates only, portioned at two balls.

dishes.name: Banana Oat Raisin Cookies
dishes.concept: Soft baked cookies of mashed ripe banana, rolled oats, raisins, cinnamon and ground flaxseed with no added sugar, butter or egg.

dishes.name: Kurdish Rice Pudding with Rosewater and Cardamom
dishes.concept: The chilled milk-and-rice dessert served in Kurdish homes and at Ramadan iftar, scented with rosewater and cardamom and dusted with cinnamon. Made with 1% milk and a measured spoon of sugar, it is lighter than the classic yet still creamy, with about 10 g of protein per bowl.

dishes.name: Iraqi Date-Filled Cookies
dishes.concept: Iraq's national cookie (Kurds bake the same kulîçe for Eid): cardamom pastry rolled around date paste, sliced into spirals and glazed with saffron. This lighter dessert uses half whole-wheat flour and sunflower oil instead of butter or ghee, and is sweetened only by the dates, about 170 kcal for two cookies.

dishes.name: Dried Apricot and Raisin Compote
dishes.concept: A chilled dessert of dried apricots and raisins simmered with cinnamon and cloves until they swell in their own golden syrup, a Ramadan and holiday favourite across Turkey and Kurdistan. Unlike the classic, it has no added sugar: the fruit alone sweetens the juice.

dishes.name: Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
dishes.concept: The simplest Kurdish dessert: thick strained yogurt with a drizzle of mountain honey and toasted walnuts. Using nonfat yogurt and a single measured teaspoon of honey per bowl keeps it light, with about 20 g of protein in each serving.

dishes.name: Baked Apples Stuffed with Walnuts and Dates
dishes.concept: A lighter take on the Turkish dessert of apple halves filled with walnuts: instead of poaching in sugar syrup, the apples bake soft with a date, walnut and cinnamon filling and a clove in each half. No added sugar, and about 7 g of fiber per serving.

dishes.name: Orange and Pomegranate with Rosewater and Mint
dishes.concept: A simple no-cook fruit dessert with Persian flavours: juicy orange rounds scattered with pomegranate seeds, splashed with rosewater and a pinch of cardamom and finished with fresh mint. Under 100 kcal a plate, with no added sugar.

dishes.name: Berry Overnight Oats with Greek Yogurt
dishes.concept: Rolled oats soaked overnight in skim milk and nonfat Greek yogurt with chia, cinnamon, mashed banana and berries, so breakfast is ready in the fridge. Whole grain, seeds and fruit give about 13 g of fiber a jar, the banana sweetens it with no added sugar, and the yogurt brings over 20 g of protein.

dishes.name: Tofu Scramble with Spinach on Whole-Grain Toast
dishes.concept: Firm tofu crumbled into a golden turmeric and cumin scramble with spinach and cherry tomatoes, piled on whole-wheat toast with sliced avocado. A plant-based answer to scrambled eggs with about 35 g of protein, almost no saturated fat and plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Chickpea Flour Pancakes with Vegetables
dishes.concept: The North Indian savoury pancake: a thin chickpea-flour batter full of onion, tomato, spinach, ginger and coriander, cooked on a lightly oiled pan. Chickpea flour makes it naturally gluten-free and egg-free with about 15 g of protein and 8 g of fiber a plate, using only a couple of teaspoons of oil.

dishes.name: Huevos Rancheros with Black Beans
dishes.concept: The Mexican ranch breakfast: warm corn tortillas topped with smashed black beans, a fried egg and a quick cooked tomato and jalapeño salsa, finished with avocado, coriander and lime. Corn tortillas and low-sodium beans instead of cheese and fried refried beans give about 25 g of protein and 16 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Mango Chia Pudding
dishes.concept: Chia seeds set in cardamom-scented unsweetened soy milk and layered with a fresh mango and lime purée and diced mango, topped with pumpkin seeds. Ready in 20 minutes, sweetened only by the fruit, with about 10 g of fiber a glass and soy milk for protein.

dishes.name: Smashed White Bean and Avocado Toast
dishes.concept: Cannellini beans and ripe avocado smashed with lemon, garlic and chili flakes on thick whole-wheat toast, topped with cherry tomatoes, rocket and pumpkin seeds. The beans turn avocado toast into a filling breakfast with about 19 g of protein and 15 g of fiber, and the fat is the heart-healthy kind.

dishes.name: Chicken and Brown Rice Congee with Greens
dishes.concept: The Cantonese breakfast rice porridge, made with brown rice and simmered with ginger and chicken until soft and silky, then finished with shiitake, bok choy, spring onion and a few drops of sesame oil. Brown rice and greens give it fiber, lean chicken over 20 g of protein, and ginger and white pepper season it instead of soy sauce.

dishes.name: Quinoa Porridge with Banana and Peanut Butter
dishes.concept: Quinoa simmered in unsweetened soy milk with cinnamon until creamy, sweetened with mashed banana and topped with sliced banana, peanut butter and ground flaxseed. A gluten-free, plant-based porridge with about 19 g of protein and 10 g of fiber a bowl and no added sugar.

dishes.name: Chickpea Curry with Brown Rice
dishes.concept: The North Indian chickpea curry: chickpeas simmered in a thick onion, tomato and ginger masala with cumin, coriander and garam masala, finished with lemon and fresh coriander and served with brown basmati. Low-sodium chickpeas, fresh tomatoes and a modest spoon of oil make it a lighter vegan plate with about 17 g of fiber and 20 g of plant protein.

dishes.name: Lentil and Spinach Dal with Brown Rice
dishes.concept: Everyday Indian comfort food: red lentils simmered soft with turmeric, a big pile of spinach stirred through, then finished with a sizzling tadka of mustard seeds, cumin, garlic, ginger and tomato and served over brown rice. Lentils and spinach make it a vegan bowl high in fiber, plant protein, iron and folate, with only a spoon of oil per two bowls.

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken Tikka Masala
dishes.concept: The curry-house favourite made lighter: chicken breast marinated in spiced yogurt and charred under the grill, then simmered in a tomato, onion and fenugreek sauce finished with thick nonfat yogurt instead of cream and butter. Served with brown rice, it gives around 50 g of protein with very little saturated fat.

dishes.name: Tofu and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
dishes.concept: Golden pan-crisped tofu and broccoli tossed with red pepper in a glossy ginger, garlic and soy glaze over brown rice, on the table in 25 minutes. Tofu gives complete plant protein and calcium, and a measured spoon of reduced-sodium soy sauce with plenty of ginger keeps the salt well down.

dishes.name: Chicken Teriyaki with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Seared chicken breast and crisp broccoli, carrot and snow peas tossed in a glossy homemade teriyaki glaze of reduced-sodium soy sauce, ginger, garlic, rice vinegar and a single spoon of honey, over brown rice. The glaze leaves out the alcohol-based seasonings of the classic, so it is halal, and has far less sugar and salt than bottled teriyaki sauce.

dishes.name: Vegetable Bibimbap with Egg
dishes.concept: The Korean mixed rice bowl: brown rice topped with garlicky spinach, bean sprouts, carrot, zucchini and shiitake, a fried egg and a spicy-sweet chili sauce stirred through at the table. Five vegetables and whole-grain rice make it a fiber-rich vegetarian meal, and a homemade chili-flake sauce stands in for salty, sugary bottled paste.

dishes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Edamame
dishes.concept: The Hawaiian raw-fish bowl: cubes of sushi-grade salmon dressed with reduced-sodium soy sauce, ginger, lime and sesame over brown rice, with edamame, crunchy vegetables and avocado. Oily fish brings omega-3 fats and edamame adds plant protein and fiber; roast the salmon instead if you prefer it cooked.

dishes.name: Lighter Thai Green Fish Curry
dishes.concept: Thai green curry with flaky white fish, eggplant, green beans and red pepper in a fragrant lemongrass and lime broth, served with brown rice. A lighter version: about 2 tbsp of coconut milk per bowl topped up with water instead of a whole can, and a vegetarian paste with no shrimp paste, so it stays lean, with about 35 g of protein and saturated fat under 10% of energy.

dishes.name: Soba Noodle and Edamame Salad
dishes.concept: Chilled buckwheat noodles tossed with edamame, cucumber, carrot, red cabbage and scallions in a sesame, ginger and lime dressing, ready in 25 minutes and good packed for lunch. Edamame and buckwheat give over 20 g of plant protein, and the dressing leans on lime and ginger so it needs only a spoon of soy sauce.

dishes.name: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Quinoa and Vegetables
dishes.concept: Salmon fillets roasted on one tray with broccoli, peppers, zucchini and cherry tomatoes under a smoky paprika, garlic and lemon rub, served on fluffy quinoa. Oily fish brings omega-3 fats and quinoa a whole grain, for about 39 g of protein and 10 g of fiber in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowl with Brown Rice and Beans
dishes.concept: Cumin and chipotle chicken over brown rice with black beans, sweet corn, crisp lettuce, a fresh tomato salsa and avocado, topped with thick yogurt instead of sour cream and cheese. A lighter bowl with low-sodium beans and whole grains, for over 40 g of protein and about 12 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Chicken Fajitas with Peppers
dishes.concept: Lime and cumin chicken seared with sweet peppers and onion, wrapped in warm corn tortillas with a quick tomato salsa and thick yogurt instead of sour cream and cheese. Corn tortillas are whole grain and almost salt-free, so each plate brings over 40 g of protein and about 9 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Three-Bean Vegetable Chili
dishes.concept: Kidney, black and pinto beans simmered with peppers, sweet corn and tomato in a smoky chipotle, cumin and cocoa sauce, served over brown rice with avocado. Three kinds of low-sodium beans make a meat-free chili with over 20 g of protein and 22 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Lentil Bolognese with Whole-Wheat Spaghetti
dishes.concept: A rich, slow-simmered ragù of brown lentils, mushrooms, onion, carrot and celery in tomato with oregano and bay, tossed with whole-wheat spaghetti. Lentils stand in for the mince, so this lighter vegan version has about 27 g of protein and 17 g of fiber a plate with very little saturated fat.

dishes.name: Minestrone with Beans and Whole-Wheat Pasta
dishes.concept: The Italian vegetable soup: onion, carrot, celery, zucchini, green beans and kale simmered with fresh tomatoes, white and red beans and small whole-wheat pasta, finished with basil and olive oil. A vegan bowl with about 22 g of protein and 19 g of fiber, seasoned with herbs and fresh tomato instead of salty stock.

dishes.name: Tuna Niçoise Salad
dishes.concept: The salad of Nice: boiled new potatoes, green beans, eggs, cherry tomatoes and tuna on crisp lettuce with black olives and a lemon and mustard dressing. No-salt-added tuna in water and a light hand with olives keep it lean, with about 38 g of protein a plate.
keyIngredients: tuna, canned in water, no salt added (drained)

dishes.name: Moroccan Lentil and Chickpea Soup
dishes.concept: The tomato, lentil and chickpea soup that breaks the fast across Morocco in Ramadan, fragrant with ginger, turmeric, cinnamon and a big handful of coriander and parsley, thickened with a little whole-wheat flour and served with lemon and dates. This vegan version is lighter than the traditional meat-and-butter pot, with about 24 g of protein and 19 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Chicken and Apricot Tagine with Whole-Wheat Couscous
dishes.concept: Chicken thighs braised with onion, ginger, saffron and ras el hanout until tender, with dried apricots and chickpeas melting into a sweet-spiced sauce, served on whole-wheat couscous. The apricots give the sweetness, so no honey or sugar is needed, and a plate has over 45 g of protein and 14 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Chili-Lime Edamame
dishes.concept: Young soybeans boiled in their pods and tossed with garlic, chili flakes and fresh lime, the classic Japanese bar snack made with only a pinch of salt. About 100 kcal and 9 g of plant protein per bowl, and fun to pop straight from the pod.
keyIngredients: edamame in pods (frozen, weighed with pods)

dishes.name: Spiced Stovetop Popcorn
dishes.concept: Whole-grain popcorn popped in a measured spoon of oil and tossed with smoked paprika, cumin and garlic instead of butter and lots of salt. A big bowl of about 2.5 cups is around 130 kcal with nearly 4 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Apple Slices with Peanut Butter
dishes.concept: Crisp apple wedges with a spoon of natural, unsalted peanut butter and a dusting of cinnamon. Fruit fiber plus peanut protein and healthy fats make a filling 190 kcal snack with no added sugar.

dishes.name: Berry and Yogurt Smoothie
dishes.concept: Frozen mixed berries blended with nonfat Greek yogurt, half a banana for sweetness and ground flaxseed, with no added sugar or juice. Thick, cold and about 190 kcal with 12 g of protein and 6 g of fiber per glass.

dishes.name: Tropical Fruit Salad with Lime and Mint
dishes.concept: An easy, refreshing dessert of mango, pineapple, papaya and kiwi dressed only with lime and fresh mint, finished with a Thai-style pinch of chili salt. About 150 kcal and 5 g of fiber per bowl, sweet from the fruit alone.

dishes.name: Frozen Yogurt Berry Bark
dishes.concept: An easy make-ahead dessert: nonfat Greek yogurt lightly sweetened with a measured spoon of honey, spread thin, studded with fresh berries and frozen into crisp shards. About 110 kcal and 12 g of protein per serving.

dishes.name: One-Ingredient Banana "Nice Cream" with Cocoa
dishes.concept: A creamy soft-serve dessert made by blending frozen ripe banana with unsweetened cocoa and a pinch of cinnamon, with no cream or added sugar. About 115 kcal and 4 g of fiber per bowl.

dishes.name: Dark Chocolate-Dipped Strawberries
dishes.concept: An easy dessert of fresh strawberries tipped and drizzled with a small, measured amount of 70%+ dark chocolate, served with a honey-cinnamon Greek yogurt dip. About 160 kcal and 14 g of protein per serving, so the chocolate is a treat rather than the whole snack.

dishes.name: Iraqi Overnight Chicken and Tomato Rice
dishes.concept: The Baghdadi Sabbath dish of chicken slow-baked on cardamom-and-tomato rice until the base turns golden, served with a chopped cucumber and tomato salad. Skinless bone-in pieces, brown rice mixed into the basmati and a single spoon of oil make it a lighter version with over 40 g protein a plate.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Kurdish Chicken and Rice Pastry Dome
dishes.concept: The Kurdish celebration dome: spiced basmati with shredded chicken, peas, carrots and a few almonds baked inside a crisp shell of oil-brushed filo instead of buttered dough, served with a cucumber-yogurt salad. A lighter version with about 30 g protein a slice.

dishes.name: Iraqi Chicken Biryani with Vermicelli and Peas
dishes.concept: Iraqi biryani of spiced basmati with toasted vermicelli, peas, carrots and chicken, topped with a scatter of almonds and raisins. A lighter version: the potatoes are oven-roasted rather than fried and two spoons of oil replace the ghee, for about 35 g protein and 7 g fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Iraqi Chicken and Vermicelli Soup with Chickpeas
dishes.concept: A homely chicken broth with toasted vermicelli, chickpeas, carrot and celery, finished with lemon and parsley; the chickpeas and vegetables bring the fiber a noodle soup lacks, and a generous bowl gives over 30 g protein.

dishes.name: Iraqi Chicken and Potato Stew with Rice
dishes.concept: The everyday Iraqi maraq of chicken and potato in a tomato and baharat sauce sharpened with dried lime, spooned over basmati rice with a plate of fresh herbs, radish and spring onion on the side. One spoon of oil and skinless thighs keep it light.

dishes.name: Iraqi Chicken Curry with Potatoes and Chickpeas
dishes.concept: The Basra-style curry stew Iraqis eat over rice: chicken simmered with curry powder, turmeric, tomato, potato and chickpeas, with no cream or ghee. Chickpeas and potato make it filling, with around 35 g protein and 8 g fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Iraqi Eggplant and Chicken Stew with Rice
dishes.concept: An Iraqi home maraq of eggplant simmered with chicken, tomato, garlic and dried lime, served with basmati rice and fresh parsley. A lighter version: the eggplant is oven-roasted with a little oil instead of fried, giving about 9 g fiber and 30 g protein a plate.

dishes.name: Kurdish Cabbage Rolls with Chicken and Rice
dishes.concept: Blanched cabbage leaves rolled around rice, minced chicken, dill and parsley and simmered in a sour tomato and pomegranate broth. A lighter take on the lamb version, with more rice and herbs than meat.

dishes.name: Iraqi Zucchini and Chicken Stew with Rice
dishes.concept: Zucchini, chicken and tomato simmered with garlic and dried mint into a light Iraqi maraq, served with basmati rice; quick, full of vegetables and over 30 g protein a plate.

dishes.name: Iraqi Potato Kubba Stuffed with Chicken
dishes.concept: Mashed potato shells filled with minced chicken spiced with baharat, onion and parsley, served with a tomato and cucumber salad, traditionally alongside a bowl of lentil soup. A lighter version: the kubba are baked on an oiled tray instead of fried.

dishes.name: Kurdish Chicken and Freekeh Soup
dishes.concept: Smoky cracked freekeh simmered with shredded chicken, onion, carrot, tomato and dried mint into a thick village soup finished with lemon; the whole grain gives it about 8 g fiber a bowl alongside over 30 g protein.

dishes.name: Lebanese Grilled Chicken with Garlic Sauce
dishes.concept: Chicken pieces marinated in lemon, garlic and seven-spice and grilled skinless, served the Beirut way with garlic sauce, oven-roasted potato wedges, a crisp salad and whole-wheat pita. A lighter version: the toum is whipped from nonfat Greek yogurt instead of an oil emulsion and the potatoes are roasted, not fried.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lebanese Grilled Pita Stuffed with Chicken Kafta
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat pita filled with a thin layer of minced chicken, onion, parsley and seven-spice and toasted in a dry pan until crisp, served with a yogurt-tahini sauce and a chopped salad. Toasting without oil keeps it light, with about 35 g protein a plate.

dishes.name: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
dishes.concept: Yogurt-marinated chicken layered with saffron basmati, mint and oven-baked onions, then sealed and steamed on low heat so the rice cooks in the chicken juices, served with a cucumber and tomato raita. A lighter biryani: the onions are baked instead of deep-fried and a single spoon of ghee goes in for aroma, with about 40 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Pakistani Chicken Karahi
dishes.concept: Chicken cooked hard and fast in a wok with tomatoes, ginger, garlic and green chili until the sauce clings, the way roadside dhabas in Lahore and Peshawar make it, served with whole-wheat roti. A lighter karahi: a couple of spoons of oil instead of ghee, skinless chicken and very little salt, so the tomatoes and ginger do the seasoning.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken Korma
dishes.concept: A mild Mughlai korma of chicken in a silky, gently spiced sauce, served with brown basmati rice and a crunchy kachumber salad. The lighter version gets its richness from yogurt and a small handful of cashews blended into the onion base instead of cream, keeping saturated fat under 6% of energy.

dishes.name: Chicken Saag
dishes.concept: Chicken simmered in a spiced purée of spinach and kale (standing in for Punjabi mustard greens) with ginger, garlic and green chili, finished with a spoon of yogurt rather than butter and served with whole-wheat roti. The greens bring their own salt, so none is added.

dishes.name: Parsi Chicken Dhansak
dishes.concept: The Parsi Sunday dish of chicken cooked into a purée of toor dal, red lentils, pumpkin and eggplant with warm dhansak spices and a sour touch of tamarind, served with brown rice cooked with caramelized onion. The lentils make it very high in fiber, and the whole pot uses less than two spoons of oil.

dishes.name: Chettinad Pepper Chicken
dishes.concept: The fiery Tamil curry of chicken in a freshly toasted paste of black pepper, fennel, coriander, cumin and a little coconut, cooked down with tomato and onion and served with brown rice. A lighter version made with skinless chicken, a few spoons of coconut and a measured spoon of oil.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Kerala Chicken Stew with Vegetables
dishes.concept: A gentle white stew of chicken, potato, carrot and green beans in ginger, green chili and whole spices, with a measured splash of coconut milk thinned with broth, eaten with brown rice. A lighter version of the Kerala breakfast classic: broth carries most of the sauce, so saturated fat stays under 10% of energy.

dishes.name: Oven Tandoori Chicken with Kachumber
dishes.concept: Skinless chicken legs marinated overnight in yogurt, lemon and tandoori spices and roasted in a very hot oven until charred at the edges, served with kachumber salad, mint chutney and fresh whole-wheat roti. Nonfat yogurt, skinless meat and roasting instead of a butter baste make it a lean, high-protein plate.
keyIngredients: chicken drumstick, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Pakistani Chicken Yakhni Pulao
dishes.concept: Basmati rice cooked in the aromatic broth (yakhni) of chicken simmered with fennel and whole spices, so every grain carries the flavour, with chickpeas added for fiber and a cool cucumber raita alongside. Skinless chicken and a modest spoon of oil instead of ghee keep it light.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Fenugreek Chicken Curry
dishes.concept: Chicken breast in a tomato-onion masala perfumed with dried fenugreek leaves and finished with a spoon of yogurt, cooked in one pan in under half an hour and eaten with whole-wheat roti. Lean breast meat and a measured spoon of oil keep it light, with about 45 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Bengali Chicken and Potato Curry
dishes.concept: The thin, comforting Bengali Sunday curry of chicken and potatoes in a turmeric, cumin and ginger broth, eaten with rice and a pile of garlicky sautéed spinach. Skinless chicken and a spoon of oil instead of a pool of mustard oil make it a lighter jhol.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Sri Lankan Roasted Curry Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken simmered with dark-roasted curry powder, cinnamon, lemongrass and tomato and finished with a little coconut milk, served with brown rice (standing in for Sri Lankan red rice) and a green bean mallung tossed with coconut and lime. A lighter version with a measured splash of coconut milk instead of a whole can.

dishes.name: Mulligatawny Soup with Chicken and Lentils
dishes.concept: The Anglo-Indian pepper-water soup of red lentils, chicken, apple and curry spices, blended partly smooth and finished with lemon and a spoon of rice in each bowl. Lentils and lean chicken breast make it a filling one-bowl meal with no cream.

dishes.name: Peruvian Roast Chicken with Green Sauce
dishes.concept: Peru's favourite rotisserie chicken made lighter at home: skinless chicken pieces marinated in cumin, garlic, lime and paprika and roasted hot, served with an ají verde of nonfat yogurt instead of the usual mayonnaise sauce, roast sweet potato wedges in place of fries and a crisp salad.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lighter Peruvian Creamy Chili Chicken
dishes.concept: Peru's comforting shredded chicken in a golden chili sauce, made lighter: the sauce is thickened with 1% milk, whole-wheat bread and a few walnuts instead of evaporated milk and cheese, and it's served over brown rice with boiled potato and black olives.

dishes.name: Latin Chicken and Rice with Peas and Peppers
dishes.concept: The Latin American Sunday pot of chicken and rice cooked together in a cumin-scented sofrito broth with peas and sweet red peppers. This lighter version uses skinless thigh, brown rice, low-sodium broth and plenty of vegetables, all in one pot.

dishes.name: Mexican Green Pozole with Chicken
dishes.concept: Guerrero's green pozole: chicken and hominy in a broth blended with charred tomatillos, toasted pumpkin seeds, chili and coriander, topped with crunchy cabbage, radish, avocado and lime. Made with lean chicken breast and served with baked tostadas, it's a light, fiber-rich bowl.

dishes.name: Yucatecan Lime and Chicken Soup
dishes.concept: The Yucatán's tangy soup of chicken in a light tomato broth scented with lime, oregano and allspice, topped with avocado and tortilla strips. The strips are oven-crisped rather than fried, keeping this bowl light and ready in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Chicken Enchiladas in Green Salsa
dishes.concept: Corn tortillas rolled around shredded chicken and black beans and baked under a tangy tomatillo salsa. A lighter version: a modest crumble of queso fresco and lime-whipped nonfat yogurt instead of crema, with the beans adding fiber.

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken Mole Poblano
dishes.concept: Puebla's festive dark sauce of dried chiles, tomato, warm spices, sesame and a little dark chocolate, simmered with chicken and served with brown rice and black beans. This lighter version measures the nuts and seeds, fries the paste in a single spoon of oil and uses skinless thigh.

dishes.name: Colombian Chicken and Potato Soup
dishes.concept: Bogotá's beloved chicken soup: several kinds of potato and corn on the cob simmered until the potatoes melt into a thick broth scented with the herb guascas, finished at the table with capers, avocado and a spoon of nonfat yogurt in place of cream.

dishes.name: Brazilian Chicken Cassava Bake
dishes.concept: Brazil's 'little hidden one': shredded chicken stewed with tomato and onion, hidden under a smooth cassava mash and baked until golden. This lighter version makes the mash with 1% milk instead of butter and cream cheese, uses a thin layer of part-skim mozzarella and comes with green beans.

dishes.name: Cuban Mojo Roast Chicken with Black Beans
dishes.concept: Cuban roast chicken soaked in a garlicky mojo of orange and lime with cumin and oregano, roasted over onions and served with black beans, brown rice and sweet baked plantain. Skinless chicken and oven-baked plantain rather than fried keep it a lighter plate.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Puerto Rican Braised Chicken Stew
dishes.concept: The Puerto Rican home braise: chicken simmered with a fresh pepper-and-herb sofrito, tomato, potatoes, carrots and a few green olives, served with brown rice and stewed pinto beans. Skinless thigh, measured olives and low-sodium broth and beans make it a lighter version.

dishes.name: Yucatecan Achiote Chicken
dishes.concept: The Yucatán's slow-roasted chicken, marinated in earthy achiote, orange, lime and garlic and baked wrapped until it shreds, served in warm corn tortillas with black beans and lime-pickled red onion. A lighter version: skinless thigh, oven-baked, with beans mashed with only a little olive oil.

dishes.name: Guatemalan Chicken Pepián
dishes.concept: Guatemala's national stew: chicken, chayote, potato and green beans simmered in a rich recado of toasted pumpkin and sesame seeds, dried chiles, charred tomato and a little cinnamon, served with brown rice. Thickened with seeds and a toasted tortilla rather than fat, it's naturally light.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Hummus Topped with Spiced Chicken
dishes.concept: Smooth hummus topped with minced chicken fried with cinnamon and allspice and a few pine nuts, with whole-wheat pita and vegetables; a protein-rich Levantine breakfast. Low-sodium chickpeas, a measured spoon of tahini and lean chicken keep it filling without much salt.

dishes.name: Chicken Keema Stuffed Paratha with Raita
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat flatbread stuffed with dry-spiced minced chicken and peas and cooked on a griddle with a brush of oil, served with cucumber raita. A lighter take on the ghee-fried classic, with nonfat yogurt in the raita.

dishes.name: Chicken Chilaquiles Verdes with Egg
dishes.concept: Oven-baked corn tortilla pieces simmered briefly in tomatillo salsa with shredded chicken, topped with a fried egg, onion and a little queso fresco. Baking the chips instead of frying them makes this Mexican breakfast much lighter.

dishes.name: Chicken and Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
dishes.concept: Diced sweet potato, peppers and onion browned in one pan with chicken and smoked paprika, topped with an egg; a balanced savory breakfast with plenty of fiber and protein from a single spoon of olive oil.

dishes.name: Iraqi Herb and Chicken Patties
dishes.concept: Iraqi aroog patties of minced chicken, grated onion, parsley and a little flour with baharat, baked on a tray rather than fried and served with lettuce and lemon. Part of the mince is chicken breast, which keeps the saturated fat low.

dishes.name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
dishes.concept: Turmeric-lemongrass marinated chicken skewers grilled and served with a light peanut sauce made from peanut butter, lime and chili, with cucumber. Grilled lean breast and unsalted peanut butter keep this street snack light.

dishes.name: Baked Chicken Empanadas
dishes.concept: Small half-moons of whole-wheat olive-oil dough filled with chicken, onion, pepper and cumin and baked rather than fried; a snack portion is two.

dishes.name: Coronation Chicken Lettuce Cups
dishes.concept: The British curried chicken salad made lighter with thick nonfat yogurt instead of mayonnaise, with chopped apricots and almonds, spooned into crisp lettuce leaves.

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken Döner Wrap
dishes.concept: Thin slices of yogurt-and-spice marinated chicken seared on a hot pan and rolled in whole-wheat lavash with sumac onions, tomato, parsley and garlic yogurt. A home version of the street wrap, pan-seared with a spoon of olive oil and generous with salad.

dishes.name: Kolkata Chicken Kathi Roll
dishes.concept: Tikka-spiced chicken strips and onion rolled in an egg-washed whole-wheat paratha with green chutney and pickled onion, cooked with a brush of oil instead of a deep layer of ghee.

dishes.name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken Banh Mi
dishes.concept: A crusty whole-wheat roll filled with lemongrass chicken, quick-pickled carrot and radish, cucumber, coriander and chili, with a spicy lime yogurt spread in place of the usual mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken Caesar Salad
dishes.concept: Grilled chicken over romaine with whole-wheat croutons and a yogurt, lemon, garlic and parmesan dressing instead of the egg-and-oil emulsion, plus white beans for fiber. It keeps the Caesar flavour with a fraction of the fat.

dishes.name: Scottish Chicken, Leek and Barley Soup
dishes.concept: The Scottish soup of chicken and plenty of leeks simmered with pearl barley and a few prunes for sweetness, finished with parsley. Skinless chicken and barley make it a lean, filling bowl high in protein and fiber.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Iraqi Eggplant and Egg Pita
dishes.concept: The Iraqi-Jewish breakfast pita of eggplant, sliced boiled egg, boiled potato, chopped salad, tahini and a little amba, in whole-wheat pita. A lighter version: the eggplant is oven-roasted with a measured spoon of olive oil instead of fried, for about 20 g of protein and 13 g of fiber per pita.

dishes.name: Egyptian Ful Medames
dishes.concept: Small fava beans cooked from dried until soft, mashed with cumin, garlic, lemon and a spoon of olive oil and topped with tomato and parsley, with whole-wheat bread. Starting from dried beans keeps it far lower in salt than canned ful, with about 17 g of protein and 16 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Idli with Sambar
dishes.concept: Steamed fermented rice and urad dal cakes served with a toor dal and vegetable sambar soured with tamarind. Light, fermented and naturally oil-free in the idli, with about 17 g of protein and 11 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Kanda Poha with Peanuts and Peas
dishes.concept: The Maharashtrian breakfast of flattened rice tempered with mustard seeds, turmeric and onion, with peas, peanuts and lemon. Ready in 20 minutes with only a couple of teaspoons of oil, and the peas and peanuts bring it to about 13 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Japanese Breakfast with Grilled Salmon
dishes.concept: A small Japanese breakfast set of grilled salmon, brown rice, a tofu and scallion miso soup made with alcohol-free miso, and blanched spinach with sesame. A lighter miso soup and unsalted salmon keep the sodium low, and the tray carries about 38 g of protein and omega-3 fats.

dishes.name: Indonesian Mung Bean Porridge
dishes.concept: Mung beans simmered with ginger until creamy, finished with a little coconut milk and a spoon of sugar, and topped with sliced banana; a gentle, fiber-rich breakfast. A lighter version with measured coconut milk and sugar, for about 10 g of fiber and 13 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Costa Rican Gallo Pinto with Egg
dishes.concept: Black beans and brown rice fried together with onion, pepper and coriander, served with an egg and fresh tomato. Low-sodium beans and leftover brown rice make a quick, high-fiber plate with about 14 g of fiber and 20 g of protein.

dishes.name: Homemade Beans on Whole-Wheat Toast
dishes.concept: White beans simmered in a quick tomato sauce with onion and smoked paprika, far lower in sugar and salt than canned, on whole-wheat toast. Beans cooked from dried carry about 20 g of protein and 14 g of fiber a plate with no added sugar.

dishes.name: Buckwheat Pancakes with Yogurt and Berries
dishes.concept: Fluffy buckwheat and whole-wheat pancakes cooked in a lightly oiled pan, topped with Greek yogurt and berries instead of syrup. Whole-grain flours and blueberries give about 7 g of fiber a plate, and the yogurt brings it to over 20 g of protein with no added sugar.

dishes.name: Russian Cottage Cheese Pancakes
dishes.concept: Little pancakes of low-fat cottage cheese, egg and a spoon of whole-wheat flour browned in a little oil, served with yogurt and raspberries. Unsalted cottage cheese and a pinch of measured salt keep the sodium low, and each plate carries about 30 g of protein.
keyIngredients: cottage cheese, 1% fat, no salt added

dishes.name: Kedgeree with Flaked Fish and Eggs
dishes.concept: The Anglo-Indian breakfast of curried brown rice with flaked poached cod, peas, boiled egg and parsley, made with a spoon of oil instead of butter. Brown rice and lean white fish make a filling, high-protein plate with about 30 g of protein.

dishes.name: Gulf Sweet Vermicelli with Omelette
dishes.concept: The Emirati breakfast of vermicelli scented with saffron, cardamom and rosewater, lightly sweetened and topped with a thin omelette. A lighter version with whole-wheat vermicelli, less sugar and only a couple of teaspoons of oil, for about 16 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Lighter Misal Pav
dishes.concept: Maharashtra’s spicy sprouted-bean curry, made here with sprouted mung beans, topped with onion, tomato and lime and eaten with a whole-wheat roll. A lighter version with no fried farsan topping and only a spoon of oil, for about 20 g of protein and 17 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Kurdish Baked Trout with Walnut and Herb Stuffing
dishes.concept: Mountain-river trout stuffed with walnuts, parsley, dill, garlic and pomegranate molasses and baked, served with bulgur pilaf and a sumac salad, as cooked along the Zab rivers. Baking instead of frying keeps the oil to two spoons for four plates.

dishes.name: Lebanese Fish and Caramelized Onion Rice
dishes.concept: White fish laid over rice cooked in a dark broth of slowly caramelized onions and cumin, finished with a few toasted almonds and a lemony tahini sauce. The fish is oven-baked rather than fried, and a parsley salad on the side adds freshness and fiber.

dishes.name: Baghdadi Lamb and Apricot Stew
dishes.concept: The medieval Baghdad stew of lean lamb with dried apricots, chickpeas, cinnamon and coriander, served with basmati rice; fruit and legumes stretch a modest amount of meat. Lean leg and one spoon of oil keep it light, with over 9 g fiber per plate.

dishes.name: Kurdish Boiled Bulgur Kubba
dishes.concept: Kurdish kutilk: fine bulgur shells filled with lean beef, onion and walnuts, poached rather than fried and served with garlic yogurt and a herb salad. Poaching keeps the shells tender and the fat low, and whole-grain bulgur gives over 10 g fiber per plate.

dishes.name: Goan Fish Curry
dishes.concept: Firm white fish in a tangy red curry of chili, coriander, tamarind and a measured amount of coconut milk, with okra, served with brown rice. Using a little coconut milk rather than a whole can keeps saturated fat in range without losing the Goan flavour.

dishes.name: Bengali Fish Curry with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Bengal’s everyday light fish curry of pan-seared fillets in a turmeric, cumin and ginger broth with potato and eggplant, eaten with rice. A thin, brothy curry with no cream or coconut, it is one of the lightest curries there is.

dishes.name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Brown Rice
dishes.concept: Cod marinated in a little miso, ginger and honey, broiled until caramelized and served with brown rice, edamame and garlicky bok choy. A thin coat of miso does the seasoning, so the plate stays well under 500 mg sodium.

dishes.name: Baked Baja Fish Tacos
dishes.concept: Chili-lime white fish baked instead of battered and fried, in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw, avocado and a lime-yogurt sauce. Baking and a nonfat yogurt sauce make this a light, high-fiber version ready in under 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Lighter British Fish Pie
dishes.concept: Cod and salmon with peas and spinach in a milk sauce made without butter, under a potato mash lightened with milk and yogurt. A comforting family bake with over 40 g protein and about 8 g fiber per plate.

dishes.name: Peruvian Beef Stir-Fry with Tomatoes
dishes.concept: Lean sirloin strips stir-fried with red onion, tomato and chili with a splash of reduced-sodium soy and vinegar, served with oven potato wedges and brown rice instead of fries. Roasting the potatoes and using pre-cooked brown rice gets it on the table in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Kashmiri Lamb Rogan Josh
dishes.concept: Lean lamb braised in yogurt with Kashmiri chili, fennel and ginger until tender, served with brown basmati and a spinach side; trimmed leg meat keeps saturated fat in range. Nonfat yogurt and a measured spoon of oil replace the traditional pool of ghee.

dishes.name: Turkish Lamb and Yogurt Bake
dishes.concept: Lean lamb cubes braised until tender and baked under a set yogurt and egg custard made with nonfat yogurt and little butter, served with bulgur and salad. The lighter custard keeps the classic tang and golden top with a fraction of the fat.
keyIngredients: lamb cubes for stew or kebab, lean (raw)

dishes.name: Turkey and Vegetable Meatloaf
dishes.concept: Lean turkey mince loaf packed with grated carrot, zucchini, oats and herbs and glazed with tomato, with roast potatoes and green beans. Grated vegetables keep it moist without extra fat, and the plate gives over 35 g protein and 9 g fiber.

dishes.name: Turkish Stuffed Eggplant with Bulgur and Yogurt
dishes.concept: Eggplants roasted rather than fried and filled with onion, tomato, garlic and parsley softened in olive oil, served with a bulgur and chickpea pilaf and garlic yogurt to make it a meal. Roasting uses a fraction of the oil of the classic, and the plate brings over 15 g fiber.

dishes.name: Persian Bean, Herb and Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: The thick Nowruz soup of chickpeas, kidney beans, lentils, a mountain of spinach and herbs and whole-wheat noodles, topped with a swirl of tangy yogurt, mint oil and golden onions cooked with just a spoon of oil. A filling bowl with plenty of fiber and plant protein.

dishes.name: Lebanese Eggplant and Chickpea Stew
dishes.concept: Lebanese "moussaka": roasted eggplant, chickpeas, tomato and plenty of garlic baked together with dried mint, eaten warm or cold with whole-wheat pita. Roasting the eggplant instead of frying it keeps the oil to two spoons for the whole pot.

dishes.name: Kurdish Stuffed Chard with Rice and Lentils
dishes.concept: Swiss chard leaves rolled around rice, green lentils, herbs and tomato and simmered in a sour pomegranate and lemon broth. A meatless dolma where the lentils bring the protein and the chard and lentils the fiber.

dishes.name: Egyptian Koshari
dishes.concept: Cairo's street favourite of brown lentils, rice and whole-wheat pasta with a spiced tomato-vinegar sauce, chickpeas and onions crisped in the oven instead of deep-fried. Lighter than the original and still a big, filling bowl with over 12 g fiber.

dishes.name: Punjabi Kidney Bean Curry with Rice
dishes.concept: Kidney beans simmered in an onion, tomato, ginger and garam masala gravy until creamy, served with brown basmati. Punjab's comfort food with no cream or butter, and over 15 g fiber per plate.

dishes.name: Sichuan Mapo Tofu with Mushrooms
dishes.concept: Tofu cubes in a chili-bright sauce with minced shiitake standing in for the usual minced meat, a measured spoon of fermented chili bean paste and garlic, over brown rice with bok choy. Ready in 25 minutes with over 30 g plant protein.

dishes.name: Indonesian Gado-Gado
dishes.concept: Blanched green beans, cabbage and sprouts with potato, tofu, tempeh and a boiled egg under a light peanut-lime sauce: a hearty Jakarta salad. The sauce is thinned with lime and water rather than coconut milk, keeping the plate lighter.

dishes.name: Cuban Black Bean Soup
dishes.concept: Black beans simmered with a sofrito of onion, green pepper, garlic, cumin and oregano, partly mashed and finished with lime, over a scoop of brown rice. Low-sodium beans keep the salt in check, and a bowl brings over 20 g fiber.

dishes.name: Greek Baked Giant Beans in Tomato
dishes.concept: Giant white beans baked in a herby tomato, onion, carrot and celery sauce with dill and a measured drizzle of olive oil, served with whole-wheat bread. Classic tavern food made with a third of the usual oil and very high in fiber.

dishes.name: Turkish Vine Leaves Stuffed with Herbed Rice
dishes.concept: Fresh vine leaves rolled around rice, onion, currants, dill and mint cooked in olive oil and lemon and served cool. Fresh leaves instead of brined ones keep the salt down, and the oil is measured rather than poured.

dishes.name: Lebanese Dandelion Greens with Caramelized Onions
dishes.concept: Bitter dandelion or chicory greens wilted with garlic and lemon and topped with onions caramelized in a measured spoon of olive oil. A light, fiber-rich mezze that is all vegetables.

dishes.name: Persian Eggplant and Whey Dip
dishes.concept: Roasted eggplant mashed with golden onion, garlic and dried mint and swirled with a little kashk, topped with walnuts and served with cucumber sticks. Roasting rather than frying the eggplant keeps it light.

dishes.name: Turkish Thick Yogurt Dip with Herbs
dishes.concept: Strained nonfat yogurt beaten with garlic, dill, mint and a little crumbled white cheese, finished with walnuts and Aleppo pepper and served with crunchy vegetable sticks. A lighter version of the meyhane classic: nonfat yogurt and only a spoon of cheese per bowl give nearly 19 g of protein for about 210 kcal.

dishes.name: Levantine Fattoush Salad
dishes.concept: Chopped lettuce, tomato, cucumber, radish, purslane and herbs with oven-toasted whole-wheat pita and a sumac-pomegranate dressing. A lighter version that bakes the bread instead of frying it and keeps the salt to a pinch, so the sumac, lemon and molasses carry the flavour.

dishes.name: Persian Street-Style Roasted Beetroot
dishes.concept: The Tehran winter street snack of whole beetroot slow-cooked until sweet and sticky, sliced and dusted with cumin and the smallest pinch of salt. Served here with a few walnuts, as on a Persian snack tray, which makes it more filling and balances the natural salt in the beets.

dishes.name: Iraqi Date Syrup and Tahini with Apple
dishes.concept: The classic Iraqi pairing of tahini swirled with date syrup, served in a small measured dish with apple slices and a little whole-wheat bread for dipping. Measuring the syrup keeps the free sugar under 10 g, while sesame, apple and whole wheat add fiber and slow energy.

dishes.name: Egyptian Dukkah with Vegetables
dishes.concept: A toasted blend of hazelnuts, sesame, coriander and cumin served with cucumber, carrot and pepper sticks and a little whole-wheat pita, dipped first in a spoon of olive oil and then in the dukkah. Measured oil and plenty of vegetables keep a nut snack light.

dishes.name: Lighter Bhel Puri
dishes.concept: Mumbai’s puffed rice chaat tossed with onion, tomato, potato, peanuts, coriander and tamarind-mint chutneys, with no fried sev. A lighter version: dates instead of jaggery sweeten the tamarind chutney and dry-toasted peanuts give the crunch.

dishes.name: Spiced Chickpea Chaat
dishes.concept: Chickpeas tossed with red onion, tomato, cucumber, green chili, lemon and chaat-style spices, finished with pomegranate seeds; a tangy no-cook snack. Low-sodium chickpeas and lemon instead of salt give nearly 10 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Chinese Smashed Cucumber Salad
dishes.concept: Smashed cucumber dressed with garlic, rice vinegar, a few drops of sesame oil, reduced-sodium soy and chili, topped with toasted peanuts. A crunchy, cooling snack where a measured splash of soy and plenty of garlic and vinegar do the seasoning.

dishes.name: Lighter Mango Sticky Rice
dishes.concept: A small portion of sticky rice in lightly sweetened coconut milk thinned with water, under plenty of ripe mango and toasted sesame. A lighter version of the Thai dessert: a fraction of the usual coconut milk and sugar, with more fruit, keeps it under 10% of energy from saturated fat.

dishes.name: Guacamole with Vegetable Sticks
dishes.concept: Avocado mashed with lime, onion, tomato, chili and coriander, served with jicama, cucumber and pepper sticks instead of chips. Crunchy vegetables cut the energy of the classic dip and add fiber, with only a pinch of salt.

dishes.name: Cretan Barley Rusk with Tomato and Feta
dishes.concept: A crisp whole-grain rusk softened with grated ripe tomato and topped with a little feta, oregano and olive oil. Rye crispbread stands in for the Cretan barley rusk, and a small portion of feta keeps salt in check.

dishes.name: Turkish Spicy Tomato and Pepper Relish
dishes.concept: Finely chopped tomato, green pepper, onion and parsley with pepper paste, pomegranate molasses, lemon and sumac; a fresh, punchy mezze served with cucumber sticks. A measured spoon of pepper paste and no added salt keep the sodium low.

dishes.name: Peruvian Fish Ceviche
dishes.concept: Very fresh white fish cured in lime juice with red onion, chili and coriander, served with sweet potato and corn in a small snack portion. Lean, high in protein and seasoned with lime rather than salt.

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken Sauté with Peppers and Tomato
dishes.concept: A weeknight Turkish staple: diced chicken breast sautéed in one pan with green peppers, onion, ripe tomato and a spoon of pepper paste, served over coarse bulgur pilaf. A measured spoon of olive oil instead of butter keeps it light, with over 40 g of protein and about 10 g of fiber a plate in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken and Vegetable Casserole
dishes.concept: Chicken thighs baked slowly in a clay pot with eggplant, green peppers, okra, tomato and plenty of garlic until the vegetables collapse into their own juices, served with whole-wheat bread for the sauce. Mostly vegetables, with only two spoons of olive oil for the whole pot.

dishes.name: Lighter Circassian Chicken with Walnut Sauce
dishes.concept: Poached shredded chicken folded into a creamy sauce of walnuts, whole-wheat bread, garlic and the poaching broth, drizzled with red paprika oil. A lighter version with fewer walnuts than usual, served with bulgur cooked in the broth and a big crunchy salad.

dishes.name: Turkish Street Chicken and Chickpea Rice
dishes.concept: The Istanbul street-cart rice: basmati cooked in chicken broth with chickpeas, topped with shredded chicken and plenty of black pepper, with a fresh cucumber and tomato salad and homemade ayran on the side. Olive oil instead of butter and low-sodium broth and chickpeas make a lighter plate with almost 50 g of protein.

dishes.name: Chicken Beyti Kebab with Yogurt and Tomato
dishes.concept: Spiced minced chicken kebabs grilled, rolled in whole-wheat lavash and sliced into rounds, served on a light tomato sauce with garlic yogurt and charred peppers. A lighter version: a thread of olive oil instead of the usual melted butter, and strained nonfat yogurt.

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken İskender
dishes.concept: Thin slices of spiced, seared chicken thigh over toasted whole-wheat pide cubes, smothered in tomato sauce with cool garlic yogurt and grilled green peppers. A lighter version of the Bursa classic that skips the sizzling browned butter and uses strained nonfat yogurt.

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken Saç Kavurma
dishes.concept: Chicken strips seared fast and hot on a saç or wide pan with onions, green chilies, peppers, tomatoes and cumin, eaten wrapped in whole-wheat lavash with a sumac onion and parsley salad. A 30-minute high-protein plate cooked in a measured spoon of olive oil.

dishes.name: Chicken Stew on Smoky Eggplant Purée
dishes.concept: The Ottoman "sultan's delight": tomato-braised chicken thigh spooned over a smoky purée of flame-charred eggplant. A lighter version: the purée is thickened with 1% milk, a little flour and a spoon of Parmesan instead of a butter-heavy béchamel, giving about 8 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Chicken Mantı with Garlic Yogurt
dishes.concept: Tiny Kayseri-style dumplings of whole-wheat dough filled with spiced minced chicken, boiled and buried under garlic yogurt with a drizzle of Aleppo pepper and mint oil. Lighter than the lamb and butter original, with whole-wheat flour adding about 9 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken with Homemade Noodles
dishes.concept: Hand-cut whole-wheat erişte noodles simmered in chicken broth with shredded chicken, tomato and green peppers and finished with thyme, a homely Anatolian one-pot. Whole-wheat flour and lean chicken breast give over 40 g of protein and about 9 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Turkish Eggplant Musakka with Chicken
dishes.concept: The Turkish home-style musakka, with no béchamel: eggplant slices roasted in the oven rather than fried, layered with minced chicken cooked with onion, peppers and tomato, then baked until bubbling. Served with basmati rice and nonfat yogurt, it gives about 11 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Chicken and Vegetables Baked in Paper
