dishes.concept: Chicken breast, potato, carrot, peas, mushrooms and tomato sealed in parchment parcels with thyme and garlic and baked, so everything steams in its own juices. A complete, low-fat meal in a parcel with about 40 g of protein and very little washing up.

dishes.name: Bodrum Chicken Çökertme
dishes.concept: The Bodrum favourite: strips of sautéed chicken piled on crisp matchstick potatoes with cool garlic yogurt and a peppery tomato sauce. A lighter version: the potatoes are tossed in a little olive oil and baked crisp instead of deep-fried.

dishes.name: Lighter Kung Pao Chicken
dishes.concept: The Sichuan classic: diced chicken stir-fried with dried chilies, peanuts, scallion and celery in a tangy soy-vinegar glaze with only a little sugar, served over brown rice. Made lighter with lean breast, a measured spoon of oil, reduced-sodium soy and extra crunchy vegetables, it brings well over 30 g of protein per bowl.

dishes.name: Chicken Chow Mein with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Egg noodles stir-fried with chicken, napa cabbage, carrot, bean sprouts and bok choy in a light soy and ginger sauce. This lighter takeaway favourite piles in more vegetables than noodles and uses just a little oil and reduced-sodium soy.

dishes.name: Korean Spicy Stir-Fried Chicken with Cabbage
dishes.concept: Chuncheon-style chicken thighs marinated in a gochugaru, garlic and ginger paste and stir-fried with cabbage, sweet potato, onion and scallion, served with rice. The chili-flake marinade replaces the usual fermented chili paste, and reduced-sodium soy keeps it lighter while it still delivers about 35 g of protein.

dishes.name: Korean Braised Chicken with Glass Noodles
dishes.concept: Bone-in chicken braised in a glossy soy, garlic and chili sauce with potatoes, carrots, shiitake and onion, with glass noodles soaking up the juices at the end and brown rice on the side. Skinless chicken, reduced-sodium soy and a generous load of vegetables make this famous Andong market dish a lighter one-pot meal.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Japanese Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl
dishes.concept: Japanese home cooking at its simplest: chicken thigh and onion simmered in a light, gently sweet soy broth, set with softly cooked egg and slid over brown rice with wilted spinach. Brown rice, extra greens and a light hand with soy make this comforting bowl a balanced weeknight dinner in under 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Baked Chicken Katsu Curry
dishes.concept: Japanese katsu curry made lighter: chicken cutlets coated in whole-wheat crumbs and baked crisp instead of deep-fried, with a homemade curry sauce of onion, carrot and grated apple thickened with a little flour, served with rice and crisp shredded cabbage. It skips the salty, fatty boxed curry roux and still tastes like the real thing.

dishes.name: Chicken with Peppers in Black Bean Sauce
dishes.concept: Cantonese stir-fry of sliced chicken, green and red peppers and onion in a savoury sauce of fermented black beans, garlic and ginger, served over brown rice. Rinsing the black beans and using reduced-sodium soy keeps the salt in check while the beans still give a deep, rich flavour.

dishes.name: Korean Chicken Knife-Cut Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: Hand-cut whole-wheat noodles simmered in a clear chicken and garlic broth with zucchini, potato, carrot and scallion, topped with shredded chicken. The broth is made from scratch by poaching the chicken, so it needs very little salt, and the part-whole-wheat noodles add fiber.

dishes.name: Korean Glass Noodles with Chicken and Vegetables
dishes.concept: Chewy sweet potato glass noodles tossed with stir-fried chicken, spinach, carrot, shiitake, red pepper and onion in a light soy and sesame dressing. This lighter japchae uses more vegetables than noodles and just a little oil, making a colourful, gluten-light party dish into an everyday meal.

dishes.name: Cantonese Chicken with Mushrooms
dishes.concept: Tender sliced chicken stir-fried with button mushrooms, snow peas, bok choy, carrot and crisp celery in a light, clear ginger and garlic sauce, served over brown rice. A gentle, low-fat Cantonese classic that is mostly vegetables and lean protein.

dishes.name: Sichuan Dan Dan Noodles with Chicken
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat noodles in a nutty sesame, chili and vinegar sauce, topped with crisp-fried minced chicken, blanched bok choy, scallion and crushed peanuts. A lighter version of the Chengdu street snack: sesame paste is used sparingly, the chili oil is measured, and whole-wheat noodles bring over 8 g of fiber per bowl.

dishes.name: Cantonese Chicken and Mushroom Clay Pot Rice
dishes.concept: Brown rice cooked in a clay pot or heavy pan with ginger-marinated chicken thigh and shiitake steamed on top, finished with a light soy drizzle, scallion and bok choy. The Hong Kong winter favourite made lighter with whole-grain rice, lean thigh meat and a measured drizzle of soy, with a crisp golden crust at the bottom of the pot.

dishes.name: Japanese Chicken Hot Pot
dishes.concept: Fukuoka-style hot pot: bone-in chicken simmered into a light, clean broth with napa cabbage, tofu, shiitake, leek and carrot, each bite dipped in a fresh lemon and soy ponzu and eaten with brown rice. The broth itself is unsalted, so all the seasoning sits in the dipping sauce and you control how much you use.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lighter Moroccan Chicken Bastilla
dishes.concept: Saffron-cinnamon chicken, soft-set eggs and toasted almonds wrapped in oil-brushed filo and baked, with a dusting of cinnamon and a fraction of the usual sugar. Lightened with skinless thigh meat, a few sheets of filo brushed with olive oil instead of butter, and a big crunchy salad on the side.

dishes.name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Lemon and Olives
dishes.concept: Skinless chicken braised with ginger, saffron, onion and garlic until it falls from the bone, finished with fresh lemon zest and a few green olives in place of salty preserved lemon, over whole-wheat couscous. Big on protein, modest on salt and oil.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Moroccan Rfissa with Chicken and Lentils
dishes.concept: Shredded whole-wheat flatbread soaked in a fenugreek, ras el hanout and onion broth, topped with chicken and lentils. A lighter take on the celebratory dish: whole-wheat bread in place of buttery msemen and a spoon of olive oil instead of smen, with lentils for extra fiber.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Seven-Vegetable Couscous with Chicken
dishes.concept: The Friday couscous of Casablanca: whole-wheat couscous under chicken and seven vegetables (carrot, turnip, zucchini, pumpkin, cabbage, tomato and onion) with chickpeas in a saffron-ginger broth. Loaded with vegetables and fiber, made with measured olive oil.

dishes.name: Algerian Spicy Chicken with Chickpeas
dishes.concept: Algeria’s home favourite: skinless chicken simmered in a garlicky paprika and caraway sauce with chickpeas, served with whole-wheat bread for mopping. Made with measured olive oil and a light hand on salt, it is rich in protein and fiber.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Algerian Tlitli Pasta with Chicken
dishes.concept: Rice-shaped pasta steamed, then simmered in a cinnamon-scented chicken and chickpea sauce and garnished with a boiled egg, a festive Algerian dish. Whole-wheat orzo and skinless chicken keep it filling and lean.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Moroccan Chicken Kdra with Chickpeas
dishes.concept: Chicken braised with plenty of onion, saffron, turmeric and chickpeas until the onions melt into a silky golden sauce, made with olive oil instead of smen. Served with whole-wheat bread, it is high in protein and fiber.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Moroccan Spiced Roast Chicken with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Chicken rubbed with paprika, cumin, garlic, lemon and fresh coriander, then roasted golden on a bed of carrots, potatoes and onion. Skinless pieces and a measured spoon of olive oil keep this one-tray dinner lean and high in protein.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Libyan One-Pot Spicy Pasta with Chicken
dishes.concept: Libya’s beloved one-pot pasta, cooked directly in a spicy tomato and chickpea sauce with chicken so it soaks up every bit of flavour. Whole-wheat pasta and low-sodium chickpeas make it a high-fiber, high-protein weeknight dinner.

dishes.name: Moroccan Steamed Vermicelli with Chicken
dishes.concept: Fluffy steamed vermicelli domed over saffron-onion chicken and decorated with cinnamon and toasted almonds, served with a lemony carrot salad. Far less butter and sugar than tradition: a little butter for flavour and a light sweet dusting.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Spanish Garlic Chicken with Potatoes
dishes.concept: Chicken browned and braised with a generous amount of golden garlic, bay and lemon in light broth, with paprika-roasted potatoes and green beans. Skinless thighs and a measured spoon of olive oil keep the Spanish classic light.

dishes.name: Chicken and Green Bean Paella
dishes.concept: Valencian-style paella of chicken, flat green beans and large white beans with saffron, paprika and rosemary, cooked in a wide pan until a crisp crust forms underneath, without rabbit or seafood. Low-sodium broth and plenty of beans make it high in fiber and protein.

dishes.name: Portuguese Piri-Piri Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken marinated in a hot chili, garlic, lemon and paprika sauce and grilled until charred, with a tomato-onion salad and roast potatoes. Skinless pieces and a measured spoon of olive oil make the Portuguese favourite lean and protein-packed.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Turkish Filo Börek with Chicken and Herbs
dishes.concept: Filo layered with shredded chicken, spinach, onion and parsley, bound with egg and yogurt instead of butter and cheese, then baked golden and served with sliced tomato and cucumber. A lighter take on the bakery classic: a brushing of olive oil replaces the butter, and the filo seasons it so no salt is added.

dishes.name: Chinese Breakfast Crepe with Chicken
dishes.concept: The Beijing street breakfast: a thin mung bean and whole-wheat crepe cooked with an egg spread over it, scattered with scallion and coriander and wrapped around shredded chicken and crisp lettuce with a thin brush of hoisin. Whole-grain flour and mung beans give it fiber, and the chicken and egg about 30 g of protein.

dishes.name: Chicken and Spinach Egg Muffins
dishes.concept: Eggs baked in a muffin tin with shredded chicken, spinach, red pepper, scallion and a little reduced-fat cheddar, served with a slice of whole-grain toast and a little avocado. Lean chicken and plenty of vegetables stretch the eggs, keeping them light, and they reheat well for busy mornings.

dishes.name: Venezuelan Chicken Avocado Arepas
dishes.concept: Griddled corn arepas split and stuffed with the famous "curvy queen" filling: shredded chicken mashed with avocado, lime, coriander and red onion. Greek yogurt stands in for the usual mayonnaise, giving a lighter, protein-rich filling with heart-healthy fat from the avocado.

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken Breast Milk Pudding
dishes.concept: The Ottoman palace pudding: low-fat milk thickened with rice flour and silky threads of poached chicken breast, which vanish into a smooth, chewy texture. Lightly sweetened and dusted with cinnamon, it is a protein-rich, low-fat dessert with modest sugar.

dishes.name: Japanese Chicken Meatball Skewers
dishes.concept: Yakitori-style chicken meatballs seasoned with scallion and ginger, threaded on skewers, grilled and glazed with a light soy and honey tare thickened by reduction rather than sweet rice seasoning. Part lean breast in the mince keeps them light and high in protein.

dishes.name: Peruvian Chicken Causa
dishes.concept: Chilled layers of golden potato mashed with lime, chili and a little olive oil, sandwiching a creamy chicken and avocado filling made with Greek yogurt in place of mayonnaise, cut into neat squares. A lighter version of the Lima classic that is naturally gluten-free.

dishes.name: Persian Chicken and Potato Salad
dishes.concept: The Persian picnic favourite: shredded chicken, potato, egg, peas, carrot, fresh cucumber and a little pickle, dressed with Greek yogurt, olive oil, lemon and a spoon of mustard rather than a mayonnaise base, and eaten with lavash. A lighter, high-protein version of the classic sandwich salad.

dishes.name: Sichuan Bang Bang Chicken Salad
dishes.concept: Gently poached chicken, pounded and torn into shreds, piled over cucumber, carrot, bean sprouts and glass noodles and spooned with a nutty sesame, peanut, chili and vinegar dressing. A cold, high-protein salad with reduced-sodium soy and just enough peanut for richness.

dishes.name: Lao Minced Chicken Salad
dishes.concept: Minced chicken cooked in its own juices, then tossed warm with lime, a little fish sauce, toasted rice powder, shallot, chili, mint and coriander, eaten in lettuce cups with cucumber, green beans and sticky-style brown rice. Bright, fresh and high in protein, it gets its punch from herbs and lime rather than salt.

dishes.name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Pita
dishes.concept: Lemon, garlic and oregano chicken skewers grilled hot and wrapped in warm whole-wheat pita with tomato, red onion, lettuce and a thick yogurt tzatziki. Lean breast meat, nonfat yogurt and one pita per person keep this street-food favourite light and high in protein.

dishes.name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwich with Slaw
dishes.concept: Chicken thighs simmered in a homemade smoky tomato BBQ sauce sweetened with just a spoon of date syrup, pulled into tender shreds and piled on whole-wheat buns with a crunchy yogurt slaw of cabbage, carrot and sweet corn. Far less sugar and salt than bottled sauce, with plenty of fiber from the slaw and whole-grain bun.

dishes.name: Chicken Pasta Primavera
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat pasta tossed with seared chicken and spring vegetables (peas, zucchini, broccoli and cherry tomatoes) in a light sauce of garlic, olive oil, lemon, starchy pasta water and a little parmesan. A cream-free, high-fiber version of the Italian-American classic.

dishes.name: Turkish Egg and Vegetable Pide
dishes.concept: Boat-shaped whole-wheat pide filled with green pepper, tomato and spinach and baked with an egg cracked into the middle and a little crumbled white cheese. A lighter version: whole-wheat dough, a measured spoon of olive oil instead of butter and only a sprinkle of cheese, for over 10 g of fiber a pide.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
dishes.concept: Eggs poached in a cumin and paprika-spiced sauce of sweet peppers, onion and tomato, served with whole-wheat bread for mopping up. Mostly fresh tomatoes with a little canned crushed tomato and a measured spoon of olive oil keep it light and lower in sodium than the usual all-canned version.

dishes.name: Lighter Aloo Paratha with Raita
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato, peas, green chili and coriander, cooked on a dry griddle with only a brush of oil, served with a big bowl of cucumber and mint raita. A lighter version of the Punjabi breakfast: no butter or ghee, and the nonfat yogurt raita brings the protein.

dishes.name: South Indian Ven Pongal
dishes.concept: Rice and yellow moong dal cooked soft and creamy with ginger, then finished with black pepper, cumin and a few cashews sizzled in a teaspoon of ghee, served with a tamarind vegetable sambar. More dal than rice and only a spoon of ghee make it a lighter, high-fiber bowl.

dishes.name: Japanese Rolled Omelette with Rice and Edamame
dishes.concept: A thin-layered rolled omelette seasoned with a touch of reduced-sodium soy sauce and a pinch of sugar, served with brown rice, edamame and a quick cucumber salad. A balanced Japanese breakfast plate with over 25 g of protein and very little added salt.

dishes.name: Burmese Fish Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: Myanmar’s breakfast soup: rice noodles in a lemongrass, ginger and turmeric fish broth thickened with toasted chickpea flour, topped with boiled egg, coriander and lime. Lean white fish and just a little fish sauce keep this lighter version high in protein and moderate in salt.

dishes.name: Mexican Bean and Cheese Molletes
dishes.concept: Split whole-wheat rolls spread with a homemade pinto bean purée, sprinkled with a little mozzarella and toasted until bubbling, then topped with fresh pico de gallo and avocado. A lighter take on the Mexico City breakfast: low-sodium beans mashed with a little olive oil instead of the usual well-fried beans, and only a sprinkle of part-skim cheese.

dishes.name: Salmon and Avocado Rye Toast
dishes.concept: No-salt-added canned salmon mashed with yogurt, lemon and dill, piled onto whole-grain rye toast with avocado, cucumber and radish. Omega-3 fats, over 25 g of protein and plenty of fiber, without the heavy salt of smoked salmon.

dishes.name: Homemade Low-Sugar Granola with Yogurt
dishes.concept: Rolled oats, pumpkin seeds and almonds baked into crisp clusters with just a little maple syrup, oil and cinnamon, served over thick Greek yogurt with fresh strawberries. Far less sugar and fat than shop-bought granola, and the yogurt gives each bowl over 25 g of protein.

dishes.name: Apple Cinnamon Porridge with Walnuts
dishes.concept: Rolled oats simmered in 1% milk with grated apple and cinnamon until creamy, topped with toasted walnuts and a spoon of yogurt. The apple sweetens it with no added sugar, and whole oats give plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Emirati Saffron Pancakes with Date Syrup
dishes.concept: Thin yeasted pancakes scented with saffron and cardamom, served warm with creamy labneh and a measured drizzle of date syrup. This lighter version uses whole-wheat flour, skim milk and no added sugar in the batter, so the date syrup is the only sweetness.

dishes.name: Gujarati Steamed Chickpea Cake
dishes.concept: Spongy steamed cakes of chickpea flour tempered with mustard seeds, sesame and green chili, served with fresh coriander chutney and a lemony whole mung bean salad. Steamed, not fried, with only a little oil and sugar, it is a light, high-fiber vegan breakfast.

dishes.name: Japanese Natto Rice Bowl
dishes.concept: Fermented soybeans whipped with mustard and scallion over brown rice, with a light miso soup of tofu and spinach and fresh sliced cucumber. A traditional Japanese breakfast that is vegan, rich in protein and fiber, and seasoned with your own mustard rather than the salty sauce sachets.

dishes.name: Black Sea Anchovy Rice
dishes.concept: Fresh anchovies layered around a rice pilaf with currants, pine nuts, allspice and dill and baked, as made on the Black Sea coast. Oily fish gives omega-3s and plenty of protein, and a crunchy shepherd’s salad on the side adds freshness and fiber.

dishes.name: Levantine Baked Fish with Tahini Sauce
dishes.concept: White fish baked under a lemony tahini sauce with onions softened in a little oil, served with rice and a parsley salad. Sesame and onion bring fiber and the fish keeps it lean, with a spoon and a half of olive oil for four plates.

dishes.name: İzmir Meatballs with Potatoes and Peppers
dishes.concept: Lean beef köfte baked in a tomato sauce with potato wedges and green peppers, served with a shepherd’s salad. A lighter version: 95% lean beef and oven-roasted potatoes instead of fried ones keep the saturated fat low while the tray stays as homely as ever.

dishes.name: Persian Giant Meatballs Tabrizi
dishes.concept: Large meatballs of lean beef, rice, yellow split peas and herbs simmered in a saffron-tomato broth, with a prune or two at the centre. Split peas and rice stretch a modest amount of 95% lean beef into a filling, high-fiber plate.

dishes.name: Kerala Fish Moilee
dishes.concept: Fish simmered in a mild turmeric, ginger and green chili sauce with a little coconut milk and tomato, served with brown rice. A lighter version: a measured splash of coconut milk thinned with water instead of a full can, and green beans cooked in the sauce for fiber.

dishes.name: Cantonese Steamed Fish with Ginger and Scallion
dishes.concept: Whole fish or fillets steamed with ginger and finished with scallion, reduced-sodium soy and a spoon of hot oil, with rice and greens. Steaming keeps the fish silky with almost no fat, and brown rice with bok choy makes it a complete, high-fiber plate.

dishes.name: Hanoi Turmeric Fish with Dill
dishes.concept: Turmeric and galangal-marinated fish pan-seared with heaps of dill and scallion, served over rice noodles with peanuts and herbs. Seared in a couple of spoons of oil rather than fried, with lettuce, carrot and fresh herbs piled alongside.

dishes.name: Brazilian Fish and Pepper Stew
dishes.concept: Firm fish stewed with peppers, tomato, onion and coriander in a little coconut milk (instead of palm oil and lots of coconut), with brown rice. A lighter version that keeps the bright, sweet pepper flavour and gives a big plate of vegetables.

dishes.name: Greek Baked Fish with Tomatoes and Onions
dishes.concept: White fish baked on potatoes in a tomato, onion, garlic and parsley sauce with a measured drizzle of olive oil. The classic is swimming in oil; this lighter version keeps two spoons for four plates and all of the flavour.

dishes.name: Persian Saffron Fish Kebab
dishes.concept: Chunks of white fish marinated in saffron, lemon and onion juice, grilled with tomatoes and served with saffron rice, herbs and a lime wedge. Grilling needs only a brush of oil, and a Shirazi salad makes the plate fresh and filling.

dishes.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi Lettuce Bowls
dishes.concept: Thin slices of lean beef marinated in pear, garlic, ginger and reduced-sodium soy, seared and served over brown rice with lettuce, carrot and cucumber. Grated pear tenderizes and sweetens the meat with no added sugar, and lean sirloin keeps the bowls light.

dishes.name: Turkish Meatball Soup with Egg and Lemon
dishes.concept: Little lean beef and rice meatballs simmered with carrot, potato and chickpeas and finished with an egg-lemon liaison; a homely Anatolian soup. 95% lean beef and low-sodium chickpeas make it a light but filling bowl with plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Roast Turkey Breast with Root Vegetables
dishes.concept: Herb-rubbed turkey breast roasted over carrots, parsnip-style turnips, onions and potatoes, with a pan gravy made from broth instead of drippings. Skinless breast is one of the leanest proteins there is, and the tray of root vegetables brings plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Turkish Borlotti Beans in Olive Oil
dishes.concept: A classic Turkish zeytinyağlı dish made into a full meal: borlotti beans braised with carrot, potato, onion, garlic and tomato in olive oil, finished with lemon and parsley and served with a coarse bulgur pilaf. Starting from dried beans keeps the salt low, and beans plus bulgur give about 30 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Persian Pomegranate Soup
dishes.concept: A tangy-sweet Persian ash of yellow split peas, rice, beetroot and a big handful of herbs, soured with pomegranate molasses and topped with pomegranate seeds and sizzled dried mint. This meatless version is vegan and gets its protein from the split peas, with about 19 g of fiber a bowl and only a measured spoon of molasses for the sweet-sour finish.

dishes.name: Lebanese Lentil and Chard Soup with Lemon
dishes.concept: A Lebanese village soup of brown lentils, Swiss chard and potato simmered with garlic and coriander and soured with plenty of lemon, served with whole-wheat bread. Lentils and greens make it a vegan bowl with over 20 g of protein and about 12 g of fiber, and the lemon does most of the seasoning so the salt stays low.

dishes.name: Egyptian Eggplant Moussaka
dishes.concept: Egyptian meatless moussaka: slices of eggplant and green pepper baked until golden, then layered with chickpeas in a garlicky spiced tomato sauce and baked again, served with basmati rice. Baking the eggplant with a brush of olive oil instead of frying it keeps this vegan dish light, with about 18 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Lighter Dal Makhani
dishes.concept: The Punjabi slow-cooked dal of whole black urad and red kidney beans simmered until creamy with tomato, ginger and garlic, served with brown rice. A lighter version: a single spoon of butter for flavour and yogurt stirred in at the end instead of cream, so a bowl has about 24 g of protein, 16 g of fiber and very little saturated fat.

dishes.name: Soya Mince with Peas
dishes.concept: Textured soy mince cooked like a North Indian keema with onion, tomato, ginger, garlic and garam masala, with sweet peas stirred through and whole-wheat roti on the side. A quick vegan weeknight dish with about 30 g of protein and plenty of fiber, and almost no saturated fat in the curry itself.

dishes.name: Korean Soft Tofu Stew
dishes.concept: A bubbling Korean stew of silky soft tofu in a spicy gochugaru broth with shiitake, zucchini and onion, an egg cracked in at the end to poach, eaten with brown rice. This vegetarian version builds its broth from shiitake and a little reduced-sodium soy instead of anchovy or seafood stock, for about 30 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Vietnamese Tofu in Tomato Sauce
dishes.concept: A Vietnamese home-cooking staple: golden pan-seared tofu simmered in a fresh tomato and spring onion sauce seasoned with a little reduced-sodium soy, served with brown rice and garlicky stir-fried bok choy. Pan-searing instead of deep-frying keeps it light, and a plate carries over 30 g of plant protein.

dishes.name: Colombian Red Bean Stew with Plantain
dishes.concept: The Antioquian bean pot: red beans simmered soft with carrot and ripe plantain, finished with a hogao of tomato, onion and spring onion, and served with brown rice and sliced avocado. This plant-based version gets its richness from the plantain and avocado alone, with about 19 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Turkish Freekeh Pilaf with Chickpeas
dishes.concept: The smoky green-wheat pilaf of south-east Turkey: cracked freekeh cooked with onion, green pepper, tomato and chickpeas, served warm with a lemony cucumber and parsley salad. Whole grain and legumes give about 20 g of protein and a very high fiber count, with a measured spoon of olive oil instead of butter.

dishes.name: Turkish Spicy Bulgur Salad
dishes.concept: The Turkish afternoon-tea salad: fine bulgur softened in hot water and kneaded with pepper and tomato paste, then tossed with tomato, spring onion, parsley, mint, lemon and a little pomegranate molasses and scooped up with crisp lettuce leaves. A whole-grain snack with no added salt beyond what the pepper paste brings.

dishes.name: Lebanese Green Beans in Olive Oil
dishes.concept: Flat green beans braised slowly with tomato, onion and lots of garlic in olive oil, then left to cool and served at room temperature, as on every Lebanese mezze table. A vegetable-packed snack that uses a measured spoon of oil rather than the usual generous pour.

dishes.name: Moroccan Eggplant and Tomato Salad
dishes.concept: Moroccan zaalouk: eggplant and tomato cooked down with garlic, cumin and paprika into a soft, smoky dip, finished with lemon and fresh coriander and scooped up with a little whole-wheat bread. Simmering the eggplant instead of frying it means it needs only a measured spoon of olive oil.

dishes.name: Turkish Tomato, Walnut and Pomegranate Salad
dishes.concept: Finely chopped tomato, pepper, onion and parsley with walnuts, sumac and pomegranate molasses, the tangy salad of Gaziantep. The walnuts bring the richness, so this lighter version skips the usual pour of olive oil.

dishes.name: Lighter Turkish Semolina Halva
dishes.concept: Semolina toasted slowly with pine nuts in a little butter and oil, then simmered in milk with a measured spoon of sugar and dusted with cinnamon. Made with 1% milk and far less fat and sugar than the classic, and served in small portions.

dishes.name: Baked Cauliflower with Tahini
dishes.concept: Cauliflower florets roasted crisp in a hot oven instead of deep-fried, drizzled with lemony tahini and parsley and eaten with a little whole-wheat pita, the way it is tucked into sandwiches in Beirut. A lighter take with a fraction of the oil.

dishes.name: Persian Chickpea Flour Cookies
dishes.concept: Little clover-shaped cookies of chickpea flour, cardamom and rosewater, each topped with a pistachio, made for Nowruz. This version uses less sugar and oil than usual and is naturally gluten-free; two cookies make a snack.

dishes.name: Iraqi Date and Sesame Balls
dishes.concept: Basra’s pounded date and toasted sesame balls, warm with cardamom. Made from just dates, sesame and spice with no added sugar, they are a quick energy bite with tea or to break the fast.

dishes.name: Egyptian Lupini Beans with Cumin and Lemon
dishes.concept: Cairo’s street snack of lupini beans, cooked from dried and debittered in fresh water rather than kept in brine, then tossed with lemon, cumin and chili. About 10 g of protein and plenty of fiber per bowl for very little salt.

dishes.name: South Indian Moong Dal Salad
dishes.concept: A Karnataka festival salad of soaked split moong dal with grated carrot, cucumber, a little coconut, green chili and lemon, finished with a mustard seed tempering. Crunchy, fresh and protein-rich, with only a measured spoon of coconut.

dishes.name: Lebanese Cabbage Salad with Garlic and Mint
dishes.concept: Finely shredded white cabbage and tomato in a sharp garlic, lemon and dried mint dressing with a little olive oil. Crunchy, cheap and very light, it keeps its bite for hours.

dishes.name: Turkish Strained Yogurt with Hot Pepper Oil
dishes.concept: Thick garlicky strained yogurt topped with dried chilies warmed in a spoon of olive oil instead of butter, served with cucumber and carrot sticks. Nonfat Greek yogurt keeps it light and gives about 13 g of protein per bowl.

dishes.name: Lighter Mexican Street Corn
dishes.concept: Grilled corn on the cob brushed with lime yogurt and dusted with chili and a little queso fresco instead of mayonnaise and lots of cheese. All the smoky, tangy street flavour with a fraction of the fat.

dishes.name: Levantine Monk’s Eggplant Salad
dishes.concept: Smoky charred eggplant chopped with tomato, green pepper, spring onion and parsley in a pomegranate molasses and lemon dressing, without tahini. Light and bright, with only a spoon of olive oil.

dishes.name: Lighter Turkish Poached Quince
dishes.concept: Quince halves poached slowly with cloves and a little sugar until ruby red, served with a spoon of strained yogurt and walnuts instead of clotted cream. A winter dessert with about a third of the usual sugar.

dishes.name: Baked Tunisian Tuna and Egg Brik
dishes.concept: A crisp filo triangle filled with tuna, potato, parsley, capers and a soft egg, baked rather than deep-fried. A lighter take on the Tunisian Ramadan favourite with no-salt tuna and a light brush of olive oil.
keyIngredients: tuna, canned in water, no salt added (drained)

dishes.name: Persian Barberry Rice with Saffron Chicken
dishes.concept: Saffron-braised chicken with steamed basmati studded with tart barberries and a few pistachios, served with a crunchy salad Shirazi. A lighter version: skinless chicken and a spoon of olive oil instead of butter, for over 45 g of protein a plate.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken Fesenjan
dishes.concept: Chicken simmered in the famous sweet-sour sauce of ground walnuts and pomegranate molasses, served over basmati rice. A lighter version: about a quarter of the usual walnuts, with roasted butternut squash blended in for body and colour.

dishes.name: Persian Baked Saffron Rice Cake with Chicken
dishes.concept: Saffron rice bound with yogurt and egg, layered with shredded chicken and barberries and baked until a golden crust forms, served with a crisp herb salad. A lighter version: nonfat Greek yogurt, a single egg and a fraction of the usual oil.

dishes.name: Persian Eggplant and Chicken Stew
dishes.concept: Chicken braised with tomato, turmeric, dried lime and fresh lime juice, topped with silky eggplant and served with basmati rice. A lighter version: the eggplant is oven-roasted with a little olive oil rather than fried, which keeps it to a fraction of the usual fat.

dishes.name: Persian Chicken Stew with Prunes
dishes.concept: Chicken braised with golden onion, saffron and tomato and sweet-sour prunes, with yellow split peas added for fibre, served over basmati rice. Skinless chicken and one spoon of oil make it a lighter stew with nearly 50 g of protein and about 10 g of fibre a plate.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Persian Celery and Herb Stew with Chicken
dishes.concept: Celery and a big bunch of parsley and mint sautéed, then simmered with chicken and lemon into a tangy green stew, served with basmati rice. Mostly vegetables and herbs with lean chicken and measured oil, so it is light but filling.

dishes.name: Gilani Sour Herb Chicken
dishes.concept: The Caspian dish of chicken braised in a mash of coriander, parsley, mint, garlic and crushed walnuts, soured with pomegranate molasses and lime, with yellow split peas as in many Gilan kitchens. A measured handful of walnuts keeps it lighter while the herbs carry the flavour.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Persian Sour Cherry Rice with Chicken
dishes.concept: Basmati rice layered with tart cherries, little cinnamon-spiced chicken meatballs and saffron, served with a cool cucumber yogurt. A lighter version: a single spoon of sugar for the cherries instead of a syrup, and nonfat yogurt on the side.

dishes.name: Persian Barley Soup with Chicken
dishes.concept: Pearl barley simmered with shredded chicken, carrot and leek in broth, then finished with milk and lemon for the classic creamy-tangy bowl. A lighter version: low-fat milk instead of cream, with about 11 g of fibre and 38 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Northern Persian Stuffed Roast Chicken
dishes.concept: A whole skinless chicken stuffed with walnuts, herbs, barberries and a little rice, roasted on a bed of onions and served with a crisp herb salad. A lighter version: the skin comes off and the walnuts are measured, while foil keeps the meat juicy.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Persian Carrot Stew with Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken braised with julienned carrots, saffron, a little orange and dried apricot until sweet-sour and fragrant, served over basmati rice. The fruit replaces the usual sugar, and one and a half spoons of oil keep it light.

dishes.name: Shirazi Cabbage Rice with Chicken Meatballs
dishes.concept: A Shiraz home favourite: basmati steamed with sautéed cabbage and plenty of dill, basil and tarragon, layered with little chicken meatballs. Lots of cabbage and herbs and measured oil make it a light, fragrant one-pot rice.

dishes.name: Persian Noodle Rice with Chicken and Dates
dishes.concept: The Nowruz rice of basmati layered with toasted noodles and saffron, topped with a few dates and raisins cooked with onion and served with saffron chicken and lentils. Whole-wheat noodles and green lentils make it a lighter, high-fibre version of the festive dish.

dishes.name: Chicken Jalfrezi
dishes.concept: Chicken stir-fried over high heat with chunky peppers, onion and green chili in a tangy tomato masala, served with brown rice. More vegetables than sauce and lean breast meat make this a light, high-protein curry, and cooked brown rice gets it on the table in half an hour.

dishes.name: Goan Chicken Vindaloo
dishes.concept: Chicken marinated in a fiery Goan paste of dried red chili, garlic, ginger, warm spices and vinegar, then braised with potatoes until the sauce turns deep red and tangy, served with brown rice. A lighter vindaloo with a measured spoon of oil and skinless thigh meat.

dishes.name: Chicken Madras
dishes.concept: A hot, tangy South Indian-style chicken curry built on chili, coriander, cumin and tamarind with a little toasted coconut for body, served with brown rice and garlicky wilted spinach. A lighter Madras: a few spoons of desiccated coconut stand in for coconut cream, keeping saturated fat in check.

dishes.name: Chicken Handi
dishes.concept: Chicken slow-cooked in a covered clay pot (handi) with tomato, yogurt, ginger and green chili until the sauce is thick and glossy, finished with dried fenugreek and fresh coriander and served with whole-wheat roti. A lighter handi: low-fat yogurt in place of cream and a spoon or two of oil instead of ghee.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Chicken Do Pyaza
dishes.concept: A Mughlai chicken curry in which onions go in twice: once cooked down into a sweet masala and again as chunky petals that stay soft but whole, with tomato, warm spices and a little yogurt, served with whole-wheat roti. A lighter version cooked with a measured spoon of oil instead of ghee.

dishes.name: Achari Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken cooked with the whole spices used for North Indian pickles (achar): mustard, fennel, fenugreek and cumin seeds, sharpened with yogurt and lemon and served with brown rice and a crunchy kachumber salad. A lighter achari made with a measured spoon of oil rather than the usual pool of mustard oil.

dishes.name: Afghan Kabuli Pulao with Chicken
dishes.concept: Afghanistan’s national rice dish: basmati cooked in a cumin and cardamom-scented chicken broth until every grain is separate, crowned with the chicken, sweet carrot strips, raisins and a few toasted almonds. A lighter palaw with far less oil than usual and no sugar on the carrots, which get their sweetness from the raisins.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Chicken Keema with Peas
dishes.concept: Minced chicken cooked with onion, tomato, ginger and plenty of green peas into a dry, fragrant keema, served with whole-wheat roti and a cool cucumber and mint raita. A quick weeknight curry where peas add fiber and sweetness and nonfat yogurt keeps the raita light.

dishes.name: Kashmiri Chicken Yakhni
dishes.concept: Chicken simmered in a pale, delicate yogurt sauce scented with fennel, dry ginger and cardamom, with no tomato or chili, as it is cooked in Kashmir, served with basmati rice and Kashmiri-style garlicky greens (haak). The low-fat yogurt sauce is stabilised by slow, patient stirring rather than cream or extra fat.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Goan Chicken Xacuti
dishes.concept: A Goan chicken curry in a complex dark paste of roasted coconut, dried red chili, coriander, cinnamon, cloves and black pepper, served with brown rice. This lighter xacuti uses a few spoons of coconut rather than a whole grated coconut, so the spices lead and saturated fat stays under 10% of energy.

dishes.name: Chicken and Chickpea Curry
dishes.concept: Chicken and chickpeas simmered together in a Punjabi onion and tomato masala, sharpened with lemon in place of dried mango and served with whole-wheat roti. Chickpeas double the fiber and stretch the chicken, and low-sodium canned chickpeas and tomatoes keep it light on salt.

dishes.name: Chicken Kofta Curry
dishes.concept: Soft, spiced minced-chicken meatballs poached straight in a tomato and onion gravy rather than fried first, served with brown rice and a lemony cucumber salad. Poaching keeps the koftas tender and the dish light, with a spoon of gram flour binding them instead of egg or bread.

dishes.name: Peshawari Chicken Chapli Kebab
dishes.concept: The flat, crisp-edged kebabs of Peshawar made with minced chicken, crushed coriander, cumin, pomegranate seeds, tomato and green chili, served with warm whole-wheat naan and a crunchy salad. A lighter chapli: pan-seared in a thin film of oil instead of shallow-fried in fat.

dishes.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
dishes.concept: The Singapore and Malaysian classic: skinless chicken gently poached with ginger and spring onion, served with rice cooked in its fragrant broth, cucumber, ginger-scallion oil and a fresh chili-lime sauce. This lighter version toasts the rice in a spoon of oil instead of chicken fat and adds blanched greens, for about 50 g of protein a plate.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken Massaman Curry
dishes.concept: The mild southern Thai curry of chicken and potato in a sauce warm with cinnamon, cardamom and cloves, soured with tamarind and finished with toasted peanuts, served over brown rice. A lighter version: a homemade paste and just a small measure of coconut milk keep saturated fat low while the potatoes and peanuts make it rich and filling.

dishes.name: Thai Holy Basil Chicken
dishes.concept: Bangkok's favourite quick lunch: minced chicken stir-fried hard with garlic, chili and green beans, seasoned with a little soy and fish sauce and finished with a fistful of holy basil, over brown rice with a crisp-edged fried egg. A lighter plate with extra beans and brown rice, ready in under 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Thai Coconut Galangal Chicken Soup
dishes.concept: A fragrant Thai soup of chicken, mushrooms and tomato simmered in a lemongrass and galangal broth, finished with lime, fish sauce and fresh coriander, with brown rice on the side. This lighter version builds on low-sodium chicken broth with a measured splash of coconut milk, so it stays creamy and aromatic with little saturated fat.

dishes.name: Chicken Pad Thai
dishes.concept: Thailand's famous stir-fried rice noodles with chicken, tofu, egg, bean sprouts and scallion in a sweet-sour tamarind sauce, topped with peanuts, chili and lime. A lighter version with much less sugar and oil than the street-stall classic, plus extra carrot and sprouts, for about 45 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho
dishes.concept: Hanoi-style chicken noodle soup: a clear broth simmered from chicken on the bone with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon, ladled over rice noodles and pulled chicken and piled with bean sprouts, Thai basil, coriander, chili and lime. Skinless chicken keeps the broth light and fat-free, and the herbs and sprouts add freshness and fiber.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chili Chicken
dishes.concept: A fast Vietnamese home stir-fry: chicken thigh tossed in lemongrass, garlic, shallot and turmeric, seared until caramelised with chili and onion, and served with brown rice and garlicky bok choy. A measured spoon of fish sauce and plenty of aromatics keep it bold but low in sodium.

dishes.name: Vietnamese Grilled Chicken Noodle Bowl
dishes.concept: A cool, crunchy Vietnamese noodle bowl: lemongrass-marinated chicken thigh grilled until charred, over rice vermicelli with lettuce, cucumber, bean sprouts, mint, quick-pickled carrot and peanuts, dressed with a light nuoc cham. Half the usual fish sauce and sugar in the dressing and a big pile of raw vegetables keep it light and fresh.

dishes.name: Filipino Chicken Adobo
dishes.concept: The Philippines' best-loved braise: skinless chicken simmered in vinegar with a whole head's worth of garlic, bay leaves and cracked black pepper, then reduced to a tangy glaze, served with brown rice and garlicky spinach. A lighter version that leans on vinegar and garlic and uses only a little reduced-sodium soy sauce.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Filipino Ginger Chicken Soup with Papaya
dishes.concept: A gentle Filipino home soup of chicken simmered in a clear ginger, onion and garlic broth with tender green papaya, finished with wilted greens and served with brown rice. Skinless chicken and only a little fish sauce make it a light, warming bowl with over 40 g of protein.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Indonesian Turmeric Chicken Soup
dishes.concept: Indonesia's golden chicken soup: a broth fragrant with turmeric, lemongrass, galangal and shallot, poured over glass noodles, shredded chicken, cabbage, bean sprouts and boiled egg, with lime and a little rice on the side. Built on low-sodium broth with chicken breast, it is light, warming and ready in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Indonesian Chicken Fried Rice
dishes.concept: Indonesia's everyday fried rice: day-old brown rice stir-fried with chicken, shallot, garlic and chili and plenty of cabbage, carrot and green beans, glazed with a quick homemade sweet soy and topped with a fried egg, with cucumber and tomato on the side. A lighter version with whole-grain rice, extra vegetables and a measured spoon of reduced-sodium soy.

dishes.name: Lighter Malaysian Chicken Rendang
dishes.concept: The deeply spiced Malay and Minangkabau dry curry: chicken slow-cooked in a paste of shallot, lemongrass, galangal and chili with warm whole spices and tamarind until the sauce cooks down dark and clings to the meat, served with brown rice and green beans. A lighter version made with only a little coconut milk and a spoon of toasted coconut, so saturated fat stays low without losing the rich, caramelised flavour.

dishes.name: Persian Chicken Kuku
dishes.concept: A thick Persian frittata of shredded chicken, egg, potato, onion, saffron and parsley, cooked slowly in a covered pan with a single spoon of oil and served in wedges with a little lavash and sliced tomato. More chicken and potato than egg keeps it high in protein with modest saturated fat.

dishes.name: Malaysian Roti John
dishes.concept: The Malaysian and Singaporean street breakfast: a split whole-wheat roll griddled face-down on a spiced layer of minced chicken, egg and onion, then piled with cucumber, tomato and a quick fresh chili-tomato sauce. A lighter version with half chopped breast in the mince and a couple of teaspoons of oil instead of margarine.

dishes.name: Buckwheat Galette with Chicken and Mushrooms
dishes.concept: A Breton buckwheat crêpe folded around cooked chicken, garlicky mushrooms and spinach, with an egg set in the middle and a light scatter of mozzarella. A lighter take that uses lean chicken and a little cheese rather than cured meat and lots of butter; buckwheat is naturally gluten-free and high in fiber.

dishes.name: Mexican Shredded Chicken with Eggs
dishes.concept: A northern Mexican breakfast: shredded chicken fried briefly with onion, tomato and jalapeño, then scrambled with eggs and served with warm corn tortillas and black beans. Using egg whites alongside whole eggs and low-sodium beans keeps it light while packing in protein and fiber.

dishes.name: Persian Chicken and Potato Patties
dishes.concept: Golden Persian patties of minced chicken, grated potato, onion and turmeric, pan-browned in a measured spoon of oil rather than shallow-fried and served with fresh tomato and herbs. Half finely chopped breast in the mince keeps them lean and juicy.

dishes.name: Nepali Steamed Chicken Momo
dishes.concept: Steamed Himalayan dumplings with a juicy filling of minced chicken, cabbage, onion, ginger and coriander, served with a fresh tomato-sesame achar. Homemade dough keeps the salt far lower than shop wrappers, steaming means no oil, and half chopped breast in the filling keeps it lean.

dishes.name: Vietnamese Chicken Summer Rolls
dishes.concept: Fresh rice paper rolls packed with shredded chicken, rice vermicelli, lettuce, mint, carrot and cucumber, with a peanut-hoisin dip. Nothing is fried, and the dip is thinned with lime and water so a little hoisin goes a long way.

dishes.name: Baked Chicken Taquitos
dishes.concept: Corn tortillas rolled tightly around a spiced filling of shredded chicken and mashed pinto beans, brushed lightly with oil and baked crisp instead of deep-fried, with a fresh tomato salsa. Low-sodium beans add fiber and keep the salt in check.

dishes.name: Chicken Tikka Salad with Mint Yogurt
dishes.concept: Yogurt-marinated chicken tikka seared hot and piled over a crunchy chopped salad of chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion and lettuce, finished with a cool mint-yogurt dressing. Nonfat yogurt and low-sodium chickpeas make it a high-protein, high-fiber bowl with very little fat.

dishes.name: Hot and Sour Soup with Chicken
dishes.concept: A peppery, vinegary Chinese broth thick with shredded chicken, tofu, shiitake, napa cabbage and carrot, finished with silky egg ribbons and served with brown rice. Low-sodium stock and a measured splash of reduced-sodium soy keep it light but full of flavour.

dishes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup
dishes.concept: The Greek chicken and rice soup turned silky with whisked egg and lemon, here with carrot, celery and white beans added for fiber and body. Lean breast, low-sodium stock and only a spoon of olive oil make it a light, high-protein bowl.

dishes.name: Lighter Cobb Salad
dishes.concept: The American composed salad in neat rows: grilled chicken, egg, avocado, tomato, corn and black beans over crisp romaine with a tangy yogurt-mustard dressing. A lighter version with beans and corn in place of cured meat and blue cheese, giving plenty of protein and fiber.

dishes.name: Hawaiian Huli Huli Chicken
dishes.concept: Hawaiian roadside grilled chicken: boneless thighs marinated and basted with a sticky pineapple, ginger and soy glaze, served with brown rice and charred pineapple and peppers. Fresh pineapple, reduced-sodium soy and a single spoon of honey keep the glaze light on salt and sugar.

dishes.name: Persian Eggplant Kuku
dishes.concept: Roasted eggplant mashed with eggs, garlic, turmeric and walnuts and baked into a thick, soft frittata, served in wedges with whole-wheat lavash and thick yogurt. A lighter version: baked with a couple of teaspoons of olive oil rather than fried, and nonfat Greek yogurt on the side keeps the saturated fat of the eggs in range.

dishes.name: Moroccan Split Fava Soup
dishes.concept: Dried split fava beans simmered with garlic and cumin into a thick, velvety soup, topped with paprika, cumin and a thread of olive oil, with whole-wheat bread. The cold-morning breakfast of Moroccan cafés, made from dried rather than canned beans and with measured salt, for about 20 g of protein and 9 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Andhra Green Moong Dosa
dishes.concept: Crisp, thin dosas from Andhra Pradesh made from soaked whole green moong ground with ginger, green chili and cumin, scattered with onion and cooked with very little oil, served with a quick tomato and ginger chutney. No rice and no fermenting: the batter is all legume, for about 20 g of protein and 15 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Indian Spiced Scrambled Eggs with Roti
dishes.concept: Eggs scrambled with onion, tomato, green chili, turmeric and fresh coriander, the Indian street-stall breakfast, with soft whole-wheat roti. A lighter version: the rotis are dry-cooked from wholemeal atta rather than brushed with ghee and the bhurji takes only a couple of teaspoons of oil, keeping saturated fat low with about 20 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Chinese Millet Porridge with Tea Egg
dishes.concept: Golden millet simmered slowly into a smooth, comforting porridge, the everyday breakfast of northern China, served with a marbled tea egg, edamame and garlicky stir-fried bok choy. Plain millet needs no salt; the side dishes bring flavour and the protein, for about 20 g of protein and 8 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Filipino Eggplant Omelette
dishes.concept: Long eggplants charred until smoky and soft, flattened into fans, dipped in seasoned beaten egg and pan-cooked in a little oil, served with a fresh tomato and onion salad and brown rice. A lighter take on the Filipino breakfast classic, cooked in a teaspoon or two of oil rather than shallow-fried, with about 11 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Mexican Enfrijoladas
dishes.concept: Warm corn tortillas dipped in a smooth, cumin-scented black bean sauce, folded into quarters and topped with onion, crumbled queso fresco, a spoon of yogurt and coriander. Low-sodium beans, a small amount of cheese and nonfat Greek yogurt in place of crema make a lighter plate with about 20 g of protein and 14 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Sardines on Whole-Wheat Toast with Tomato
dishes.concept: Canned sardines mashed with lemon, parsley and a little ripe avocado, piled on whole-wheat toast with sliced tomato and peppery rocket. Oily fish for breakfast brings omega-3 fats and over 20 g of protein in five minutes, and the avocado and tomato balance the saltiness of the fish and bread.

dishes.name: Ricotta Toast with Figs and Walnuts
dishes.concept: Whole-grain toast spread with part-skim ricotta whipped with Greek yogurt, topped with sliced dried figs, toasted walnuts, cinnamon and a few drops of honey. Mixing the ricotta with nonfat yogurt keeps the saturated fat in check while doubling the protein, and the figs bring fiber and sweetness so it needs only a teaspoon of honey.

dishes.name: Russian Buckwheat Kasha with Mushrooms and Egg
dishes.concept: Toasted buckwheat groats cooked until fluffy and nutty, tossed with mushrooms and onion sautéed in olive oil instead of the usual butter, and topped with a soft-boiled egg and fresh dill. Buckwheat is a gluten-free whole grain, and this bowl carries about 17 g of fiber and 18 g of protein.

dishes.name: Yemeni Bread and Egg Scramble
dishes.concept: Torn whole-wheat bread toasted in the pan and scrambled with eggs, tomato, onion, green pepper and cumin, a Yemeni breakfast that uses up yesterday’s bread. A lighter version cooked in a measured spoon of oil instead of samn, with plenty of vegetables for volume.

dishes.name: Gujarati Fenugreek Flatbreads with Yogurt
dishes.concept: Thin, soft flatbreads of whole-wheat and chickpea flour kneaded with yogurt, fenugreek leaves, ginger, green chili and turmeric, cooked on a hot pan with a light brush of oil and served with cool yogurt. The Gujarati travel breakfast, made here with dried fenugreek and less oil than usual, for about 20 g of protein and 9 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Black Bean and Egg Breakfast Burrito
dishes.concept: A whole-wheat tortilla rolled around soft scrambled egg, cumin black beans, pan-crisped potato and peppers, fresh tomato salsa and avocado. Low-sodium beans and potatoes stretch two eggs into two filling burritos with about 18 g of fiber each and no cheese or sour cream.

dishes.name: Turkish Fish Braised with Vegetables in Olive Oil
dishes.concept: White fish braised in a little olive oil with carrot, potato, celery, onion, garlic and lemon, served warm or cool with bread. A lighter take on the meyhane classic: a measured three spoons of oil for four plates instead of a pool of it.

dishes.name: Lebanese Baked Fish Kibbeh
dishes.concept: A tray of fish and fine bulgur kibbeh scented with orange zest, coriander and cumin over a layer of caramelized onions, baked. Baking in a measured spoon or two of oil keeps it light, and the bulgur gives it plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Turkish Stuffed Eggplant with Beef
dishes.concept: Eggplants roasted (not fried) and split open, filled with lean minced beef, onion, peppers and tomato and baked; served with rice and yogurt. Roasting instead of deep-frying the eggplants and using 95% lean beef make it a much lighter plate.

dishes.name: Persian Lamb, Chickpea and Bean Stew
dishes.concept: Lean lamb slow-simmered with chickpeas, white beans, potato, tomato and dried lime; the broth is eaten with bread and the rest is mashed. This lighter version uses lean shank meat instead of fatty cuts and tail fat, and the pulses give it over 10 g of fiber a bowl.
keyIngredients: lamb shank meat, lean (raw, off the bone)

dishes.name: Bengali Mustard Fish
dishes.concept: Fish simmered in a sauce of ground mustard seeds, turmeric and green chili with a little oil, with eggplant and rice. A spoon of oil per two plates keeps it light, and the eggplant, as in shorshe begun, adds fiber.

dishes.name: Korean Braised Mackerel with Radish
dishes.concept: Mackerel braised with radish, onion and a gochugaru-garlic sauce, with reduced-sodium soy and brown rice. Oily fish brings omega-3 fats, and reduced-sodium soy keeps the spicy, savoury sauce in check.

dishes.name: Cambodian Steamed Fish Amok
dishes.concept: Fish steamed in a lemongrass-turmeric curry paste with a little coconut milk and egg until just set, served with brown rice and greens. A measured splash of coconut milk keeps the saturated fat low while the fresh kroeung paste carries the flavour.

dishes.name: Fish Veracruz Style
dishes.concept: Fish baked in a tomato sauce with onion, garlic, a few olives, capers and jalapeño, served with brown rice. Fresh tomatoes and just a handful of olives and capers keep the sodium moderate in this bright Gulf-coast dish.

dishes.name: Istanbul Stuffed Mackerel
dishes.concept: Mackerel emptied and filled with its own flesh mixed with rice, onion, currants, pine nuts, allspice and dill, then baked rather than fried, with a shepherd salad and bread. Baking instead of the usual flour-and-egg frying keeps it lighter, and the oily fish brings omega-3 fats.

dishes.name: Cuban Shredded Beef Stew
dishes.concept: Lean flank steak braised with peppers, onion, tomato and cumin until it shreds, with black beans and brown rice. Low-sodium beans and whole-grain rice make it a high-fiber plate with about 35 g of protein.

dishes.name: Xinjiang Cumin Lamb Stir-Fry
dishes.concept: The Uyghur halal classic of lean lamb stir-fried with cumin, chili, onion and peppers, served with brown rice and a cucumber salad. Lean leg meat and a quick, hot stir-fry in a little oil keep it light and high in protein.

dishes.name: Yemeni Tandoor-Baked Fish
dishes.concept: Fish rubbed with hawaij-style spices, garlic and lemon and baked very hot, served with a tomato-coriander salsa and flatbread. A very hot oven stands in for the clay mofa oven, so it needs only a little oil.

dishes.name: Lighter Greek Moussaka
dishes.concept: Roasted eggplant and potato layered with a lean beef, tomato and cinnamon sauce under a yogurt-egg topping instead of béchamel. Roasting instead of frying the eggplant, 95% lean beef and a nonfat Greek yogurt topping make a lighter moussaka with over 40 g of protein.

dishes.name: Turkish Green Lentil Stew with Bulgur
dishes.concept: The everyday Turkish home stew: green lentils simmered with onion, carrot, pepper paste and a spoon of coarse bulgur until thick and spoonable, then finished with dried mint and lemon. Measured olive oil and pepper paste keep it light, and the lentil and whole-grain pairing gives about 20 g of protein and 13 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Persian Turmeric Rice with Lima Beans
dishes.concept: A homely Persian one-pot from Tehran kitchens: basmati rice steamed with lima beans, turmeric and plenty of dill, crowned with a fried egg and served with cool yogurt. Eggs cooked in a nonstick pan with a little oil and nonfat yogurt keep it light, and the beans bring the protein and fiber.

dishes.name: Lebanese Pumpkin Kibbeh with Spinach
dishes.concept: The meatless Lenten kibbeh of Lebanon: a dough of roasted pumpkin and fine bulgur pressed into a tray around a tangy filling of spinach, onion, chickpeas and sumac, then baked until crisp at the edges. Brushed with a measured spoon of olive oil and baked rather than fried, it is a filling vegan tray with lots of fiber.

dishes.name: Moroccan Vegetable and Chickpea Tagine
dishes.concept: Carrot, sweet potato, zucchini and chickpeas braised in a fragrant ras el hanout and tomato sauce with dried apricots, served over fluffy whole-wheat couscous. Seasoned with spices, lemon and herbs rather than salty stock, it is a vegan plate with about 20 g of plant protein and plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Black-Eyed Pea Curry
dishes.concept: A North Indian and Pakistani home curry of black-eyed peas simmered in a tomato and onion masala with ginger, garlic and garam masala, served with brown basmati. Cooked from dried peas with only a modest spoon of oil, it is a vegan bowl with about 20 g of protein and more than 10 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Gujarati Dal Dhokli
dishes.concept: The Gujarati one-pot comfort meal: spiced whole-wheat dough dumplings simmered in a tangy toor dal with tomato, peanuts and warm whole spices, finished with lemon and coriander. Made without the usual jaggery and with a measured tadka, it is a vegan bowl with about 18 g of protein and plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Chinese Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry
dishes.concept: The classic Chinese home dish: soft-scrambled eggs folded into juicy tomatoes in a light savory-sweet sauce with scallions, here with edamame stirred through and served over brown rice. Using precooked brown rice makes it a 20-minute plate with about 28 g of protein and a measured spoon of oil.

dishes.name: Burmese Chickpea Tofu Salad
dishes.concept: Shan tofu is made from chickpea flour, not soy: cooked into a thick turmeric batter, set, sliced and tossed with crisp cabbage, onion, roasted peanuts, garlic oil, lime and chili. Served with brown rice, it is a bright vegan meal with about 18 g of plant protein and only a measured splash of soy sauce.

dishes.name: Peruvian Bean and Rice Cake
dishes.concept: The thrifty Lima favorite: beans and rice mashed with onion, garlic and chili, pan-crisped into a golden cake and topped with a fried egg and a sharp salsa criolla of red onion and lime. Brown rice, low-sodium beans and a nonstick pan instead of plenty of oil make a lighter version with about 11 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Greek Spinach Rice with Feta
dishes.concept: The Greek home classic of short-grain rice simmered with heaps of spinach, dill, onion and spring onion, sharpened with lemon and served with a small crumble of feta and lemony white beans. A modest amount of feta and no added salt keep sodium in check, and the beans make it a full meal with about 18 g of protein.

dishes.name: Turkish Broad Bean Purée with Dill
dishes.concept: An Aegean meze: dried split broad beans cooked soft with onion, puréed with olive oil and lemon, set in a dish and served cool in slices scattered with dill. This lighter version uses a measured amount of olive oil, and each slice is a protein-rich snack.

dishes.name: Persian Spinach and Yogurt Dip
dishes.concept: A classic Persian borani: wilted spinach and gently cooked garlic folded into thick yogurt, scented with a little saffron and topped with chopped walnuts. Made with nonfat strained yogurt, it is a creamy, protein-rich dip with very little saturated fat.

dishes.name: Lebanese Lemon-Garlic Potato Salad
dishes.concept: The Lebanese mezze potato salad: boiled potatoes, skins on, dressed while warm with lemon, crushed garlic, fresh mint, parsley and a little olive oil. No mayonnaise, just bright herbs and citrus.

dishes.name: Lighter Turkish Candied Pumpkin
dishes.concept: Pumpkin slowly poached in its own juices with a little sugar, cinnamon and cloves, served cool and topped with toasted walnuts. A lighter version with far less sugar than tradition: about 7 g per serving and roughly 115 kcal.

dishes.name: Turkish Purslane Salad with Yogurt
dishes.concept: Fresh, lemony purslane folded into thick garlic yogurt and finished with olive oil warmed with Aleppo pepper. Strained nonfat yogurt keeps it light and protein-rich, with no added salt needed thanks to the garlic and pepper.

dishes.name: Lighter Lebanese Turmeric Semolina Cake
dishes.concept: A golden turmeric and fennel-scented semolina cake made with almond milk and part whole-wheat flour, topped with sesame. A lighter version with about half the usual sugar and oil: roughly 140 kcal and 8 g of sugar per square.

dishes.name: Persian Shirazi Salad
dishes.concept: Finely diced cucumber, tomato and red onion with dried mint, lime and a spoon of olive oil, served with crisp baked whole-wheat flatbread for scooping. Bright and very light, seasoned with lime and mint instead of salt.

dishes.name: Moroccan Almond Honey Spread with Apple
dishes.concept: Roasted almonds ground with a little argan oil and honey into a rich spread, served in a measured spoonful with crisp apple and whole-wheat toast. A lighter version with much less oil and honey than the Souss original, at about 3 g of added sugar per serving.

dishes.name: Persian Pumpkin and Yogurt Borani
dishes.concept: Turmeric-roasted pumpkin folded into thick garlic yogurt with dried mint and a few toasted walnuts. Roasting instead of frying the pumpkin and using strained nonfat yogurt make it a light, protein-rich dip at about 125 kcal a bowl.

dishes.name: Baked Potato and Pea Patties
dishes.concept: Spiced potato and pea patties with cumin, ginger and green chili, baked crisp on a lightly oiled tray instead of shallow-fried and served with a fresh mint and coriander chutney. A lighter take on the street snack at under 180 kcal for three patties.

dishes.name: Gilani Eggplant, Walnut and Pomegranate Dip
dishes.concept: Smoky charred eggplant mashed with walnuts, garlic, dried mint and pomegranate molasses, the sweet-sour dip of Gilan on the Caspian coast, served with cucumber sticks and a little whole-wheat bread. Only a teaspoon of oil is needed, as the walnuts bring the richness.

dishes.name: Fresh Singapore Spring Rolls
dishes.concept: Soft, thin wheat wrappers rolled around garlicky braised jicama and carrot, golden tofu, bean sprouts, lettuce and crushed peanuts, with a smear of hoisin and fresh chili. Unfried and packed with vegetables, one roll is a satisfying snack of about 230 kcal.

dishes.name: Jicama Sticks with Chili and Lime
dishes.concept: Crisp jicama, cucumber and orange with a squeeze of lime and a dusting of chili powder, as sold in cups by Mexican street vendors. Crunchy, juicy and very low in calories, with about 8 g of fiber per serving.

dishes.name: Turkish Artichokes in Olive Oil
dishes.concept: Artichoke hearts gently braised with onion, carrot, potato and peas in olive oil and lemon, then cooled with fresh dill, as in Aegean homes. A lighter version with a measured two spoons of oil in the pot and very little salt.

dishes.name: Turkish Fig and Milk Pudding
dishes.concept: Dried figs blended into warm milk and left to set into a soft pudding by their own natural enzymes, then topped with walnuts and cinnamon. Sweetened only by the figs, with no added sugar; it needs about 4 hours to set.

dishes.name: Salmon Rice Balls
dishes.concept: Sticky short-grain rice mixed with brown rice and toasted sesame, filled with flaked salmon and spring onion and wrapped in crisp nori. Two rice balls make a filling snack with about 11 g of protein; no-salt-added salmon and a pinch of salt on the hands keep sodium low.

dishes.name: Saudi Chicken Kabsa
dishes.concept: Saudi rice cooked in a tomato and kabsa-spice chicken broth with carrot and dried lime, topped with the chicken and a few almonds and raisins, served with a tomato daqoos salsa. Skinless chicken, a measured spoon of olive oil and fresh salsa and cucumber on the side make it a lighter, high-protein plate.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Yemeni Chicken Mandi
dishes.concept: Spice-rubbed chicken roasted over saffron-cardamom rice so the juices drip in, served with a green chili-tomato sahawiq and a crunchy salad. Skinless pieces and one spoon of oil keep it lean, with over 40 g of protein a plate.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Hejazi Creamy Chicken Rice
dishes.concept: The Taif dish of short-grain rice simmered in chicken broth and milk until creamy, topped with roast chicken, served with garlicky green beans and a tomato salad. A lighter version made with 1% milk and a teaspoon of ghee instead of lots of butter.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Gulf Chicken and Vegetable Saloona
dishes.concept: The everyday Emirati stew of chicken with potato, zucchini, carrot, eggplant and tomato in a baharat and dried-lime broth, with rice. Skinless chicken and a pot full of vegetables give about 8 g of fiber a bowl.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Emirati Chicken Thareed
dishes.concept: Pieces of whole-wheat regag bread soaked in a spiced chicken, pumpkin and chickpea stew; the Ramadan dish, made lighter with whole-grain bread, chickpeas and lots of vegetables.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Saudi Chicken Margoog
dishes.concept: Thin whole-wheat dough sheets cooked in a chicken and vegetable stew with tomato, zucchini and pumpkin; a Najdi winter dish. Whole-wheat flour and plenty of vegetables give nearly 10 g of fiber a bowl.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Yemeni Chicken Soup with Hawaij
dishes.concept: A turmeric, cumin and black pepper hawaij chicken soup with potato, carrot and chickpeas, finished with coriander and lemon. A light, warming one-pot meal with skinless chicken and over 40 g of protein a bowl.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Yemeni Chicken Saltah with Fenugreek Froth
dishes.concept: A bubbling stew of shredded chicken, potato, tomato and okra topped with whipped fenugreek (hilbeh) and eaten with flatbread. Lean breast meat, a modest piece of whole-wheat bread and measured salt keep it light.

dishes.name: Egyptian Molokhia with Chicken
dishes.concept: Jute leaves simmered in chicken broth with garlic and coriander, poured over rice with poached chicken and served with a tomato-cucumber salata baladi. A lighter version: the garlic taqleya is fried in a spoon of olive oil instead of ghee, and the chicken is skinless.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Egyptian Chicken-Stuffed Baked Bread
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat pita stuffed with minced chicken, onion, pepper, chili and spices and baked crisp, with a lemony tahini salad. Minced chicken in place of fatty beef and a light brush of olive oil instead of butter keep it lighter, with about 30 g of protein.

dishes.name: Egyptian Okra and Chicken Stew
dishes.concept: Okra and chicken simmered in a tomato, garlic and coriander sauce, served with vermicelli rice. Boneless skinless thighs and a measured spoon of oil keep it lean, with about 6 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Egyptian Baked Vegetables with Chicken
dishes.concept: A tray of zucchini, potato, carrot, peas and green beans baked in a tomato sauce with chicken pieces, served with rice. Skinless thighs and a measured spoon of olive oil make it a light, vegetable-packed family bake.

dishes.name: Lighter Egyptian Macarona Béchamel
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat penne layered with a spiced minced chicken and tomato sauce under a béchamel made with 1% milk and little butter. A lighter take on the Egyptian family bake, with whole-grain pasta for about 7 g of fiber and nearly 30 g of protein a portion.

dishes.name: Malaysian Chicken in Spiced Tomato Sauce
dishes.concept: The festive Malay "red-cooked" chicken: skinless pieces simmered in a deep red sauce of chili, tomato, lemongrass, cinnamon and star anise, with peas and onion rings, served with brown rice and cool cucumber. This lighter version browns the chicken in a hot oven instead of deep-frying it and uses fresh tomatoes and a measured pinch of salt.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lighter Northern Thai Curry Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: Chiang Mai's famous bowl: egg noodles and tender chicken in a golden turmeric-curry broth, topped with crisp noodles, raw shallot, coriander and a squeeze of lime, with bok choy for greens. A lighter version that builds the broth on low-sodium stock with only a small measure of coconut milk, so it stays creamy but low in saturated fat.

dishes.name: Manado Spicy Chicken
dishes.concept: A fiery North Sulawesi favourite: chicken stir-fried in a fresh paste of red chili, shallot, garlic, ginger and lemongrass, finished with tomato, spring onion, basil and lime, over brown rice with garlicky wilted spinach. Bright, hot and lean, and on the table in half an hour.

dishes.name: Thai Grilled Chicken with Papaya Salad
dishes.concept: The classic Isan pairing: skinless chicken marinated in garlic, coriander root and white pepper and grilled until smoky, served with a crunchy, sour-hot papaya and green bean som tam, cabbage wedges and sticky-style brown rice. The salad is made with just a little sugar and fish sauce and the chicken is grilled, so it is light, high in protein and full of crunch.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Filipino Chicken Afritada
dishes.concept: A homely Filipino braise of chicken in tomato sauce with potatoes, carrots, red pepper and peas, scented with bay leaf and served with brown rice. This lighter version uses skinless chicken, a single spoon of oil and a measured pinch of salt, and is packed with vegetables.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Vietnamese Caramelized Ginger Chicken
dishes.concept: A home-style Vietnamese braise: chicken thigh simmered in a dark caramel with plenty of ginger, shallot and a little fish sauce until sticky and glazed, with brown rice and blanched bok choy. Just a spoon of sugar makes the caramel, so it stays low in sugar and ready in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Balinese Spiced Chicken
dishes.concept: Bali's ceremonial chicken: skinless pieces rubbed with base genep, a golden paste of turmeric, ginger, shallot, chili, lemongrass and warm spices, then sealed and slow-steamed in their own juices until tender, served with brown rice and long beans stir-fried in the same paste. Steaming instead of frying keeps it lean, high in protein and full of fibre.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Filipino Rice Noodles with Chicken and Vegetables
dishes.concept: The party noodle of the Philippines: thin rice noodles tossed with sliced chicken breast, cabbage, carrot, snow peas and celery in a light soy and chicken broth, served with lime wedges to squeeze over in place of calamansi. Lean breast meat and a heap of vegetables make this a light, quick, high-protein plate.

dishes.name: Vietnamese Chicken Curry with Sweet Potato
dishes.concept: A gentle, fragrant Saigon curry of chicken, sweet potato, carrot and onion in a lemongrass and curry-powder broth, mopped up with a crusty whole-wheat roll in the Vietnamese way. This lighter version uses only a small measure of coconut milk and a little fish sauce, so it is creamy but low in saturated fat and salt.

dishes.name: Thai Stir-Fried Wide Noodles with Chicken
dishes.concept: Bangkok street-stall noodles: wide rice noodles seared in a hot wok with chicken, egg and a big pile of Chinese broccoli in a light soy sauce, with chili vinegar on the side. A lighter version with extra greens, lean breast meat and reduced-sodium soy, ready in under 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Thai Ginger Chicken Stir-Fry
dishes.concept: A gentle Thai home stir-fry of sliced chicken breast with a generous tangle of fresh ginger, mushrooms, onion, red pepper and spring onion in a light soy sauce, over brown rice. Lean, quick and full of vegetables, with ginger doing most of the seasoning.

dishes.name: Burmese Chicken Curry
dishes.concept: A Burmese everyday curry: chicken slowly cooked in a pounded base of onion, garlic and ginger with turmeric and paprika until the sauce turns deep red and the oil rises, served with brown rice and a light, tangy tamarind spinach soup. Traditional versions float in oil; this one uses a fraction of it and lets slow cooking bring out the flavour.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Filipino Chicken Glass Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: A comforting Filipino soup of slippery glass noodles in a garlicky, annatto-tinted chicken broth with shredded chicken breast, cabbage, carrot, celery and mushrooms, finished with scallion and lime. Light but filling, high in protein and ready in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
dishes.concept: The Italian hunter-style braise: chicken thighs simmered slowly with peppers, mushrooms, onion, tomato and rosemary in broth until the sauce turns thick and glossy, served over whole-wheat pasta. Skinless thighs, a measured spoon of olive oil and whole-grain pasta make it a lighter, high-fiber version of the Sunday classic.

dishes.name: Lighter Chicken Piccata
dishes.concept: Thin chicken cutlets dusted with flour, pan-seared until golden and finished in a bright pan sauce of lemon, broth and a few capers, with short whole-wheat pasta and broccoli. A lighter version: a reduced broth sauce replaces the usual butter, and whole-grain pasta and broccoli make it a complete, fiber-rich plate in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Chicken Pizzaiola
dishes.concept: Neapolitan-style chicken cutlets simmered in a quick tomato, garlic and oregano sauce and topped with a little melted mozzarella and basil, served with crisp oregano roast potatoes and wilted spinach. A small amount of part-skim mozzarella and no added salt keep the pizza flavour while holding sodium and saturated fat down.

dishes.name: Spanish Chicken in Saffron-Almond Sauce
dishes.concept: A festive Castilian braise of chicken thighs in a golden sauce thickened the old way, with almonds, garlic, saffron and hard-boiled egg yolk pounded together and stirred into the broth, served with rice and peas. A measured spoon of olive oil and a small handful of almonds keep this lighter than the traditional fried version.

dishes.name: Tuscan Chicken with White Beans and Kale
dishes.concept: Golden pieces of chicken thigh simmered in one pan with cannellini beans, kale, fresh tomato, garlic and rosemary, finished with a squeeze of lemon. The beans bring creaminess and fiber without any cream, and there is no added salt because the canned beans already carry enough.

dishes.name: Greek Chicken and Orzo Bake
dishes.concept: A Greek Sunday dish of chicken baked in a cinnamon- and allspice-scented tomato sauce, then finished in the oven with short whole-wheat pasta that drinks up the juices, topped with a little crumbled feta. Skinless chicken and a modest sprinkle of cheese make this a lighter take on the family favourite.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Chicken and Mushroom Barley Risotto
dishes.concept: A creamy risotto-style dish made with pearl barley instead of white rice, folded with seared chicken, browned mushrooms and peas and finished with lemon and a modest grating of parmesan. Barley stays pleasantly chewy and brings about four times the fiber of risotto rice.

dishes.name: Basque Chicken with Peppers
