dishes.concept: The southwest French classic of chicken braised with a soft, sweet stew of red and green peppers, ripe tomato, onion and garlic, warmed with smoked paprika and a little cayenne in place of Espelette pepper, served with rice. Skinless chicken and fresh vegetables keep it light and naturally low in salt.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: White Chicken and Bean Chili
dishes.concept: A pot of white beans and chicken breast simmered in broth with onion, green chili, green pepper, cumin and oregano until thick, then finished with lime, coriander and a spoon of nonfat yogurt instead of sour cream and cheese. Beans cooked from dry keep it low in salt, with about 12 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Chicken Jambalaya
dishes.concept: Louisiana Creole one-pot rice with chicken, the classic trio of onion, celery and green pepper, tomato and a smoky Cajun-style spice mix of paprika, cayenne, thyme and oregano. A lighter version made with brown rice and plenty of chicken in place of sausage.

dishes.name: Hungarian Chicken Paprikash
dishes.concept: Chicken thighs braised with plenty of onion and sweet Hungarian paprika until the sauce turns deep red, then finished with thick yogurt instead of sour cream, over egg noodles with a crisp cucumber and dill salad. Yogurt keeps the classic creaminess with far less saturated fat.

dishes.name: Georgian Chicken and Tomato Herb Stew
dishes.concept: A Georgian home stew of chicken braised with a mountain of onions and ripe tomatoes, seasoned with coriander and blue fenugreek, then finished with raw garlic and handfuls of coriander, basil and dill. Served with warm kidney beans and whole-wheat bread for a fiber-rich plate cooked with very little fat.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Georgian Garlic Milk Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken roasted until golden, then baked for a few minutes more in a rich garlic sauce, served with boiled potatoes and green beans. This lighter version of the Racha region favourite uses 1% milk thickened with a spoon of flour instead of cream and skinless chicken instead of fried skin-on bird.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Whole-Wheat Chicken and Cabbage Steamed Buns
dishes.concept: Fluffy steamed buns made with half whole-wheat dough and filled with minced chicken, napa cabbage, ginger and scallion; two buns and a glass of unsweetened soy milk make a filling Chinese breakfast. A lighter filling of half chopped breast and half mince keeps the saturated fat low.

dishes.name: Savory Oatmeal with Chicken, Egg and Greens
dishes.concept: Rolled oats cooked congee-style in low-sodium broth with ginger, topped with shredded chicken, a soft-boiled egg, wilted spinach and scallion. A quick, warming bowl with whole-grain fiber and plenty of protein.

dishes.name: Chicken and Black Bean Breakfast Quesadilla
dishes.concept: A whole-wheat tortilla folded around shredded chicken, mashed black beans, spinach and a little cheese, toasted in a dry pan and served with a fresh tomato salsa and avocado. Low-sodium beans and a modest sprinkle of reduced-fat cheese keep it light.

dishes.name: Lebanese Chicken Livers with Pomegranate Molasses
dishes.concept: Chicken livers seared hot with garlic and finished with lemon juice and pomegranate molasses, the classic Lebanese mezze, served as a small plate with a little warm whole-wheat pita. Livers are lean and rich in iron, and a couple of teaspoons of olive oil is all the pan needs.

dishes.name: Pakistani Chicken and Chana Dal Shami Kebab
dishes.concept: Soft patties of chicken breast and chana dal simmered with whole spices, ground smooth, bound with egg and pan-browned in a little oil, served with a nonfat-yogurt mint chutney. A lighter version of the Pakistani teatime favourite, made with lean breast and shallow-fried in a spoon of oil rather than deep-fried.

dishes.name: Korean Chicken Rice Rolls
dishes.concept: Seaweed rolls of mixed brown and white rice wrapped around seasoned chicken, spinach, carrot, cucumber and a thin omelette strip, sliced into bite-size rounds. Brown rice adds fiber, and the rolls pack easily for a snack on the go.

dishes.name: Black Sea Chicken Pide
dishes.concept: Boat-shaped whole-wheat pide topped with diced chicken, green pepper, onion and tomato and a light scatter of mozzarella, baked very hot and served with a sumac shepherd salad. A lighter version: whole-wheat dough, lean breast and a modest amount of cheese instead of a butter-brushed crust.

dishes.name: Chicken Wonton Soup with Greens
dishes.concept: Plump chicken and shiitake wontons and whole-wheat noodles in a clear ginger-scallion broth with bok choy. Half chopped breast in the filling, low-sodium broth and whole-wheat noodles make it a lighter bowl with extra fiber.

dishes.name: Vietnamese Chicken and Cabbage Salad
dishes.concept: Shredded chicken tossed with crisp cabbage, carrot, red onion, mint and toasted peanuts in a sharp lime, garlic and chili dressing, served over rice noodles. Fresh, crunchy and quick, with a measured splash of fish sauce for seasoning.

dishes.name: Chicken Pesto Pasta with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat pasta tossed with seared chicken, blistered cherry tomatoes and green beans in a bright basil pesto. A lighter pesto: white beans blended in for creaminess means it needs far less oil and cheese.

dishes.name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: Tender chicken, carrot, celery and onion simmered in a thyme-scented broth with egg noodles, with white beans added for fiber. Low-sodium broth and lots of vegetables make this comfort classic a lighter everyday meal.

dishes.name: Lean Chicken Burger with Slaw
dishes.concept: A juicy patty of chicken mince, chopped breast and grated zucchini on a whole-wheat bun with lettuce, tomato, red onion and a tangy yogurt-mustard sauce, with a crunchy cabbage and carrot slaw on the side. Pan-cooked in a little oil, with nonfat yogurt in place of mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Chinese Chicken Salad with Mandarin
dishes.concept: The American deli favourite made fresh: shredded chicken with napa cabbage, carrot, edamame, juicy orange segments and toasted almonds in a ginger-sesame dressing. Toasted almonds stand in for the usual fried wonton strips, keeping it light and crunchy.

dishes.name: Turkish Herbed Curd Cheese Salad
dishes.concept: Soft unsalted curd cheese mixed with parsley, dill, spring onion, Aleppo pepper and olive oil, with tomato, cucumber, a few olives and whole-wheat bread, as on a Turkish breakfast table. Unsalted 1% cottage cheese stands in for lor, so the plate carries over 20 g of protein with very little sodium or saturated fat.
keyIngredients: cottage cheese, 1% fat, no salt added

dishes.name: Egyptian Wheat Berry Milk Porridge
dishes.concept: Whole wheat berries simmered until plump and chewy, then warmed in milk with raisins, cinnamon and a few almonds and sweetened with a little honey, the way Egyptians eat it on winter mornings. A lighter version with 1% milk and only a couple of teaspoons of honey, giving a whole-grain bowl with about 15 g of protein, plenty of fiber and almost no sodium.

dishes.name: Vegetable Rava Upma
dishes.concept: The South Indian breakfast of toasted semolina cooked into a soft savoury porridge with mustard seeds, onion, ginger, carrot, peas and peanuts, finished with lemon and coriander. A lighter version made with a couple of teaspoons of oil instead of ghee and plenty of vegetables, for a filling vegan bowl with about 8 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Masala Oats with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Rolled oats cooked savoury, Indian-style, with onion, ginger, tomato, carrot, peas, turmeric, cumin and garam masala, then topped with cool yogurt and coriander. A homemade answer to instant masala oats with measured salt and nonfat yogurt, giving about 10 g of fiber and 16 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Korean Street Egg Toast
dishes.concept: The Seoul street-stall sandwich: a thick omelette packed with shredded cabbage, carrot and spring onion, folded into whole-wheat toast with a slice of reduced-fat cheese. A lighter version without the usual margarine and sugar: a little oil in the pan and crisp apple slices on the side for the sweet note.

dishes.name: Colombian Milk and Egg Soup
dishes.concept: The Bogotá breakfast of eggs poached in a light milk and spring onion broth, finished with fresh coriander and eaten with toasted whole-wheat bread torn into the bowl. Diced potato simmered in the broth makes it a fuller, lighter-salted meal, with about 20 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Venezuelan Fresh Corn Pancakes
dishes.concept: Sweet corn kernels blended with whole-grain cornmeal into a thick batter and griddled into golden pancakes, folded around a little crumbled fresh cheese and served with cumin-scented black beans. A lighter version that skips the butter and sugar and keeps the cheese to a small spoonful, with over 20 g of protein and plenty of fiber from the corn and beans.

dishes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes with Yogurt
dishes.concept: Blender pancakes of oats, ripe banana, eggs and milk cooked in a lightly oiled pan and topped with thick Greek yogurt and blueberries. Whole oats replace white flour and the banana does the sweetening, so a stack has about 25 g of protein, plenty of fiber and no added sugar.

dishes.name: Catalan Tomato Bread with Egg
dishes.concept: Thick slices of toasted whole-wheat bread rubbed with garlic and ripe tomato and drizzled with olive oil, topped with a fried egg and warm white beans tossed in grated tomato and smoked paprika. Whole-wheat bread and the beans add fiber and protein, and with no salt added the olive oil and tomato do all the seasoning.

dishes.name: Black Sea Herb Omelette Crêpe
dishes.concept: A thin batter of eggs, whole-wheat flour and milk packed with parsley, dill and spring onion, cooked like a crêpe-omelette in a lightly oiled pan and served with tomato, cucumber and whole-wheat bread, as on the Black Sea coast. Olive oil replaces the usual butter, and whole-wheat flour adds fiber, for about 20 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Whole-Wheat Waffles with Yogurt and Berries
dishes.concept: Crisp waffles made from whole-wheat flour and oats, topped with thick Greek yogurt and fresh strawberries instead of syrup and cream. Whole grains and fruit give over 8 g of fiber a plate, a teaspoon of honey in the batter is all the added sweetness, and the yogurt brings the protein.

dishes.name: Kerala Puttu with Black Chickpea Curry
dishes.concept: Steamed cylinders of rice flour layered with a little grated coconut, served with kadala curry, a spiced black chickpea gravy with onion, tomato, ginger and coriander, the classic Kerala breakfast. A lighter version with a small amount of coconut and a couple of teaspoons of oil: a vegan, gluten-free plate with about 16 g of protein and over 11 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Maltese Ftira with Tuna and Tomato
dishes.concept: A whole-wheat roll split and rubbed with tomato paste and fresh tomato, then filled with tuna, white beans, red onion, a few capers and mint and soaked with olive oil, like the Maltese ftira and ħobż biż-żejt. No-salt tuna and only a few capers keep the sodium down, and the roll carries over 30 g of protein.
keyIngredients: tuna, canned in water, no salt added (drained)

dishes.name: Turkish Swordfish Skewers
dishes.concept: Swordfish cubes marinated in lemon, olive oil and bay, grilled with peppers and tomatoes, with bulgur pilaf. The Aegean meyhane skewer made with a measured spoon of oil and a whole-grain pilaf, for close to 40 g of protein and plenty of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Southern Persian Stuffed Fish
dishes.concept: Fish stuffed with coriander, parsley, garlic, tamarind and barberries and baked, with plain basmati rice and a cucumber and tomato salad. A Persian Gulf coast dish from Bushehr and Khuzestan: a big handful of herbs does the seasoning and a measured spoon of oil replaces the usual frying of the stuffing.

dishes.name: Turkish Beef and Vegetable Stew
dishes.concept: Lean beef simmered with onion, tomato, peppers, carrots and potato, served with bulgur pilaf. A lighter version of the lokanta favourite, with lean chuck, a measured spoon of olive oil instead of butter and lots of vegetables in the pot.

dishes.name: Lean Persian Kabab Koobideh
dishes.concept: Skewers of extra-lean minced beef with grated onion and saffron, grilled with tomatoes and served with saffron rice and herbs. A lighter version of the Tehran kabab: 95% lean beef instead of fatty mince, no butter on the rice, and a plate of fresh herbs, radishes and sumac onions on the side.

dishes.name: Kerala Fish in Banana Leaf
dishes.concept: Fish coated in a spicy shallot, tomato and chili masala, wrapped in banana leaf and pan-roasted, with brown rice. A lighter take on the Kerala classic: the fish is pan-roasted in its parcel rather than fried first, and only a splash of coconut milk goes into the masala.

dishes.name: Filipino Sour Tamarind Fish Soup
dishes.concept: Fish in a tamarind broth with radish, eggplant, okra, green beans and spinach, served with rice. A light, very sour Filipino home soup made from real tamarind rather than a salty soup mix, with brown rice and a pot full of vegetables.

dishes.name: Ecuadorian Tuna and Cassava Soup
dishes.concept: Fresh tuna and cassava in a cumin-tomato broth topped with lime-pickled red onion and coriander. Ecuador's favourite morning-after soup is naturally light: lean tuna, filling cassava and a bright, onion-sharp finish with only a spoon of oil in the pot.

dishes.name: Sicilian Pasta with Sardines and Fennel
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat pasta with sardines, fennel, onion, raisins and pine nuts and toasted breadcrumbs. The Palermo classic made with canned sardines, a measured spoon of olive oil and whole-wheat pasta, so it brings omega-3s, nearly 30 g of protein and lots of fiber.

dishes.name: Lighter New England Fish Chowder
dishes.concept: Cod, potato, corn, onion and celery in a milk-based chowder without cured meat or cream. A lighter version thickened with a little whole-wheat flour and 1% milk, so it stays creamy with very little saturated fat and about 37 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Cuban Beef Picadillo
dishes.concept: Lean minced beef with tomato, onion, peppers, a few olives and raisins, with black beans and brown rice. A lighter Havana weeknight plate: 95% lean beef, just a handful of olives for the salty notes and low-sodium beans for plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Thai Grilled Beef Salad
dishes.concept: Sliced grilled sirloin with cucumber, tomato, red onion, mint and coriander in a lime-chili dressing, with rice. A bright, fresh Thai salad with lean steak, a toasted-rice crunch and brown rice on the side; the dressing uses just a little fish sauce and no oil.

dishes.name: Tunisian Fish Couscous
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat couscous with fish, pumpkin, potato and chickpeas in a spicy tomato broth. The coastal Tunisian couscous of Sfax and Djerba, made lighter with whole-wheat grains, low-sodium chickpeas and a measured spoon of olive oil, for over 40 g of protein and lots of fiber.

dishes.name: Baked Chiles Rellenos with Turkey and Beans
dishes.concept: Roasted mild chiles stuffed with lean turkey, black beans and corn and baked under tomato sauce with a little cheese instead of being battered and fried. A lighter version of the Mexican classic, with over 30 g of protein and plenty of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Gaza Lentil and Eggplant Pomegranate Stew
dishes.concept: The tart, garlicky stew of Gaza: brown lentils and eggplant simmered soft, then thickened with tahini and soured with pomegranate molasses and lemon, finished with a fried paste of garlic, dill and green chili. A measured spoon of olive oil keeps it light, and with toasted whole-wheat bread for scooping it gives about 20 g of protein and plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Damascene Lentils with Pasta and Tamarind
dishes.concept: A sweet-sour Damascus favourite: brown lentils and pasta pieces simmered with tamarind and pomegranate molasses, then topped with crisp onions, crunchy pasta and garlicky coriander. In this lighter version the onions and pasta are crisped in the oven with a measured spoon of olive oil instead of deep-fried, and whole-wheat pasta adds to the fiber.

dishes.name: Smoky Eggplant Bharta with Dal and Roti
dishes.concept: Eggplants charred over a flame until smoky, then mashed into a spiced onion, tomato and ginger masala, served with a simple whole moong dal and whole-wheat roti. Cooked with a little oil instead of ghee, it is a filling vegan plate with about 18 g of protein and lots of fiber.

dishes.name: Nepali Dal Bhat Plate
dishes.concept: The everyday Nepali plate: a creamy black lentil dal with garlic and ginger, steamed basmati rice, a potato and cauliflower tarkari and garlicky wilted spinach. Cooked with a measured spoon of oil instead of ghee, it is a balanced vegan meal with about 23 g of protein and lots of fiber.

dishes.name: Buddha’s Delight Vegetable and Tofu Braise
dishes.concept: The Chinese New Year vegetarian classic: golden tofu, shiitake, napa cabbage, carrot and snow peas braised in a light ginger and soy broth with slippery glass noodles, served over brown rice. Pan-browned tofu in a little oil and reduced-sodium soy sauce keep it light, with about 25 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Korean Cold Soy Milk Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: Korea’s summer noodle bowl: thin noodles in an ice-cold, nutty broth of freshly blended soybeans and toasted sesame, topped with crisp cucumber and tomato. Whole-wheat noodles and whole soybeans make it a refreshing vegan meal with about 29 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Indonesian Tempeh in Chili Sambal
dishes.concept: Crisp strips of tempeh and long beans tossed in a sweet, sour and fiery chili, shallot and tomato sambal, served over brown rice. This lighter version pan-browns the tempeh in a little oil instead of deep-frying it, for about 28 g of protein a plate in 30 minutes.

dishes.name: Peruvian Pumpkin Stew
dishes.concept: A golden Peruvian stew of pumpkin, potato, corn and peas cooked with chili, garlic and oregano until the pumpkin melts into a thick sauce, finished with an egg per person and a little queso fresco. A lighter version with a single spoon of olive oil, no cream or evaporated milk, and only a small amount of cheese.

dishes.name: Turkish Cabbage, Bulgur and Chickpea Stew
dishes.concept: A winter staple of Anatolian homes: shredded cabbage stewed with onion, tomato and pepper paste until silky, with coarse bulgur and chickpeas cooked right in the pot and a finish of dried mint. Made without meat and with measured olive oil and pepper paste, it is a thrifty one-pot meal with lots of fiber.

dishes.name: Persian Cabbage and Bean Soup
dishes.concept: A thick Persian ash of cabbage, chickpeas, lentils and rice with a mountain of fresh herbs and turmeric, crowned with golden onions and sizzled mint oil. Made without kashk or meat and with a measured amount of olive oil, it is a hearty vegan bowl with about 20 g of protein and lots of fiber.

dishes.name: Jordanian Tomato Skillet
dishes.concept: The simplest Jordanian pan supper: ripe tomatoes cooked down with garlic, green chili and olive oil into a chunky, juicy sauce, scooped up with warm whole-wheat pita. A measured spoon of oil and just a pinch of salt let the tomatoes speak.

dishes.name: Persian Steamed Fava Beans with Golpar
dishes.concept: The winter street snack of Iran: fava beans steamed in their skins until tender, then splashed with vinegar and dusted with golpar or cumin. Steaming rather than boiling in salted water keeps the salt to a pinch, and the beans bring plenty of fiber and plant protein.

dishes.name: Moroccan Spiced Carrot Salad
dishes.concept: A staple of the Moroccan salad table: tender carrot coins tossed while warm in a dressing of cumin, paprika, garlic, lemon and a little olive oil, then finished with parsley. No added salt is needed, since the carrots, spices and lemon carry plenty of flavour.

dishes.name: Turkish Noah’s Pudding
dishes.concept: A grain and legume pudding of wheat berries, chickpeas, white beans and dried fruit, lightly sweetened and topped with walnuts, pomegranate and cinnamon. A lighter version with much less sugar than usual: the dried fruit does most of the sweetening, for about 7 g of added sugar a bowl.

dishes.name: Turkish Leeks in Olive Oil
dishes.concept: Leeks gently braised with carrot, onion and a spoon of rice in olive oil and lemon, then served cool, as on every Turkish meze table. A measured amount of olive oil keeps it light without losing its silky texture.

dishes.name: Persian Grated Apple with Rosewater
dishes.concept: Crisp apple grated into its own juice and scented with rosewater and lime, served ice-cold as a summer refresher. Made with no added sugar: the apples are sweet enough on their own.

dishes.name: Iraqi Roasted Eggplant Salad
dishes.concept: Smoky roasted eggplant chopped with tomato, onion and parsley, dressed with lemon and a little pomegranate molasses. Roasting rather than frying the eggplant keeps it light, with only a spoon of olive oil.

dishes.name: Tunisian Grilled Pepper Salad
dishes.concept: Peppers, chilies, tomato and onion charred under the grill, then peeled and chopped with garlic, caraway, coriander and lemon. A bright, smoky salad dressed with just a spoon of olive oil.

dishes.name: Lighter Saffron Shrikhand
dishes.concept: Thick strained yogurt whipped with saffron, cardamom and a little sugar, topped with pistachios, the classic dessert of Gujarat and Maharashtra. A lighter version made with nonfat Greek yogurt and much less sugar, for about 14 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Steamed Vegetable Gyoza
dishes.concept: Thin dumplings filled with napa cabbage, shiitake, tofu, ginger and spring onion, crisped on the base and then steamed in the same pan. Pan-steamed with a little oil instead of deep-fried, and served with a light vinegar dip.

dishes.name: Turkish Okra in Olive Oil
dishes.concept: Tender okra braised with tomato, onion, garlic and lemon in a little olive oil, served at room temperature as a meze. Lemon keeps the okra bright and firm, and a single spoon of oil keeps it light.

dishes.name: Javanese Sweet Braised Tempeh
dishes.concept: Tempeh simmered in a spiced broth of shallot, garlic, ginger, coriander and tamarind until it soaks up a sticky glaze, then seared on a hot grill pan. A lighter version that is grilled instead of deep-fried, with far less sugar than the usual palm sugar syrup.

dishes.name: Smoky Black Bean Dip with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Black beans blended with lime, cumin, garlic and smoky chipotle into a creamy dip, served with crunchy carrot, cucumber and pepper sticks. Low-sodium beans and no added salt keep it light, with plenty of fiber per bowl.

dishes.name: Persian Rice Flour Cookies
dishes.concept: Tender, melt-in-the-mouth rice flour cookies scented with cardamom and rosewater, topped with pistachios, a Nowruz favourite. A lighter version with less sugar and oil than usual and naturally gluten-free; two cookies make a snack.

dishes.name: Turkish Black-Eyed Pea Salad
dishes.concept: Tender black-eyed peas tossed with red onion, parsley, dill, lemon and olive oil, an Aegean meze served at room temperature. Cooking the peas from dry keeps the salt measured, and herbs and lemon do the rest.

dishes.name: Sardine and Lemon Pâté on Rye
dishes.concept: Sardines mashed with nonfat yogurt, lemon, dill and red onion, spread on rye crispbread and topped with cucumber. A quick, oily-fish snack rich in omega-3 fats and protein, with yogurt instead of butter or cream cheese.

dishes.name: Oven Chicken Shawarma Plate
dishes.concept: Thighs marinated in yogurt, lemon, garlic and shawarma spices, roasted hot and sliced, with garlic yogurt, a tabbouleh-style bulgur salad and half a whole-wheat pita each. A lighter plate than the street wrap: oven-roasted chicken, nonfat yogurt in place of toum and salad in place of fries.

dishes.name: Levantine Chicken Fatteh
dishes.concept: Layers of oven-toasted pita, allspice rice and shredded chicken with warm chickpeas under a cool garlic yogurt, finished with pine nuts. A lighter fatteh: the bread is baked rather than fried and the yogurt is nonfat, for over 40 g of protein a plate.

dishes.name: Lebanese Chicken over Spiced Rice
dishes.concept: Rice cooked in chicken broth with a little browned minced chicken, cinnamon, allspice and peas, topped with poached chicken and toasted almonds and served with a garlicky yogurt-cucumber salad. Skinless chicken and a handful of nuts rather than a ghee-rich pot keep it a lighter party dish.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lebanese Pearl Couscous with Chicken
dishes.concept: Large pearl couscous simmered in a caraway and cinnamon chicken broth with chickpeas and small whole onions, topped with the poached chicken. Skinless chicken, low-sodium chickpeas and a single spoon of oil make it a light winter bowl with around 9 g of fiber.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Syrian Chicken in Warm Yogurt Sauce
dishes.concept: Chicken simmered with cardamom and cinnamon, then finished in yogurt stabilised with a spoon of cornstarch and topped with garlic and dried mint, served with vermicelli rice and a chopped salad. Low-fat yogurt and chicken thigh in place of lamb make it a lighter take on the Damascus classic.

dishes.name: Jordanian Chicken Mansaf
dishes.concept: Chicken poached with cardamom and turmeric, then simmered in a tangy cooked yogurt sauce standing in for jameed, served over golden rice on thin bread with toasted almonds and a chopped salad. Skinless chicken, low-fat yogurt and a single sheet of bread keep it a lighter everyday mansaf.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Eggplant Stuffed with Chicken in Tomato Sauce
dishes.concept: Small eggplants roasted until soft, split and filled with spiced minced chicken, onion and pine nuts, then baked in a garlicky tomato sauce and served over rice. A lighter take on the Levantine classic: the eggplants are oven-roasted rather than deep-fried and lean chicken replaces lamb.

dishes.name: Syrian Pomegranate Molasses Roast Chicken
dishes.concept: Skinless chicken thighs marinated in pomegranate molasses, lemon, garlic and seven spice and roasted over potatoes, onions and whole garlic until sticky, with a parsley-rich bulgur salad. A measured spoon of molasses gives the sweet-sour glaze while keeping free sugar low.
keyIngredients: chicken thigh, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Palestinian Chicken Qidreh
dishes.concept: The Hebron pot of rice baked with chicken, chickpeas, whole garlic cloves, cardamom and turmeric until fragrant and golden, traditionally sealed in a clay pot and slow-cooked in a baker's oven. Skinless chicken and a single spoon of oil in place of samneh make it a lighter version.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Lebanese Chicken Meatballs in Tomato
dishes.concept: Allspice-scented minced chicken meatballs with pine nuts, oven-browned and simmered with plenty of soft onions in tomato sauce, served with vermicelli rice. Baking the meatballs rather than frying them and using chicken instead of lamb make it a lighter weeknight dish.

dishes.name: Bedouin Zarb-Style Roast Chicken and Vegetables
dishes.concept: Baharat-spiced chicken roasted slowly over potatoes, carrots, onions and zucchini so the juices drip into the vegetables, as in the Jordanian underground barbecue, with a lemony chopped salad. Skinless chicken and two spoons of oil make it a light, protein-rich family tray.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Turkish Chicken and Vegetable Stew
dishes.concept: Chicken stewed slowly with eggplant, zucchini, green beans, okra, green pepper and fresh tomato, served with coarse bulgur pilaf. Packed with summer vegetables and cooked in measured olive oil, it brings well over 10 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Persian Quince and Chicken Stew
dishes.concept: Chicken braised with golden quince wedges, yellow split peas, saffron and a touch of lemon until the quince turns soft and blush pink, served over basmati rice. Made with measured olive oil and no added sugar, it is a light autumn khoresh with plenty of fiber from the split peas and fruit.

dishes.name: Green Masala Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken thigh simmered in a fresh green sauce of coriander, mint, green chili, ginger and yogurt, with peas stirred through and brown rice alongside. The herbs carry the flavour, so it needs only a little salt and a measured spoon of oil, and with cooked rice it is ready in half an hour.

dishes.name: Bangladeshi Chicken Bhuna
dishes.concept: Chicken on the bone slowly fried with onion, tomato and whole and ground spices until the masala turns thick, dark and clinging, the Bangladeshi way, eaten with fresh whole-wheat roti. A lighter bhuna: a couple of spoons of oil instead of a pool of it, skinless chicken, and roti made at home from whole-wheat flour with barely any salt.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: British Balti Chicken
dishes.concept: The Birmingham balti: chicken flash-cooked over high heat with peppers, onions and spinach in a quick tomato curry sauce, brought to the table in the pan and eaten with naan. Lean breast meat, a measured spoon of oil, extra vegetables, half a naan each and no added salt keep it light and fast.

dishes.name: Kolhapuri Chicken
dishes.concept: A fiery Maharashtrian chicken curry built on a dark roasted masala of dried red chili, sesame, coconut, onion and whole spices, served with brown rice. A lighter Kolhapuri: a few spoons of desiccated coconut give the body that a heap of fresh coconut and oil usually would, and the chicken is skinless.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Andhra Chicken Curry
dishes.concept: A hot Andhra chicken curry with red chili, a roasted coriander masala and a sour edge of tamarind, finished with mustard seeds and bay leaf in place of the usual curry leaves, served with brown rice. Skinless chicken on the bone, a measured spoon of oil and plain cayenne and paprika (rather than a salted chili blend) keep it light and low in salt.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Black Pepper Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken breast in a pale, creamy-tasting sauce of yogurt and blended cashews, sharp with plenty of coarsely crushed black pepper, eaten with fresh whole-wheat roti. A lighter kali mirch: yogurt and a small handful of cashews stand in for cream, and the roti is made at home with barely any salt.

dishes.name: Sri Lankan Chicken Kottu Roti
dishes.concept: The Sri Lankan street-food favourite: chopped roti stir-fried on a hot griddle with curried chicken, cabbage, carrot, leek and egg until everything is mixed and lightly crisp. This version uses roti made at home from whole-wheat flour, a measured amount of oil and low-sodium broth for the curry gravy, so it is full of fiber and far lighter than the street version.

dishes.name: Sri Lankan Devilled Chicken
dishes.concept: Chicken stir-fried with chunky onion, green pepper and tomato in a sticky, sweet-hot chili sauce, a Sri Lankan favourite served with brown rice. A lighter devilled chicken: the chicken is seared rather than deep-fried and the sauce gets its body from tomato paste and a single spoon of sugar instead of ketchup and chili sauce.

dishes.name: Balochi Roast Chicken Sajji
dishes.concept: Chicken rubbed simply with lemon, cumin, black pepper and garlic and roasted slowly until tender and golden, in the style of Balochistan, with cumin rice, roast potatoes and a crisp cucumber salad. Sajji is traditionally heavily salted; this version uses a light hand with salt and lets the lemon and spices do the work, and the bird is skinned.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Himalayan Chicken Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: A warming bowl of noodles in a ginger and garlic chicken broth with spinach, carrot, cabbage and a little chili, as it is eaten across Nepal, Ladakh and Sikkim. Lean chicken breast, plenty of vegetables and low-sodium broth make it a light, complete meal in a bowl.

dishes.name: Indo-Chinese Chilli Chicken
dishes.concept: The Kolkata and Mumbai favourite: chicken tossed in a hot wok with peppers, onion, green chili and lots of garlic in a sharp soy and vinegar sauce, served with brown rice. A lighter take: the chicken is lightly coated and seared rather than battered and deep-fried, and reduced-sodium soy keeps the salt in check.

dishes.name: Goan Chicken Cafreal
dishes.concept: Chicken marinated in a vivid green paste of coriander, green chili, garlic, ginger, cinnamon and vinegar, then pan-roasted until the paste chars at the edges, served Goan-style with brown rice and an onion, tomato and cucumber salad. Skinless chicken and a spoon of oil in place of the usual generous frying keep it light.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Malabar Chicken Curry with Roasted Coconut
dishes.concept: A Kerala chicken curry from the Malabar coast, its red gravy built on desiccated coconut roasted with coriander, fennel and chili until dark and fragrant, served with brown rice. Only a few spoons of coconut go in (a lighter take than one made with coconut milk), and canola oil stands in for coconut oil to keep saturated fat in check.

dishes.name: Japanese Chicken Yakisoba
dishes.concept: Noodles stir-fried with chicken, cabbage, carrot, shiitake and onion in a light homemade yakisoba sauce of reduced-sodium soy, tomato, rice vinegar and a touch of honey, so it keeps the sweet-tangy flavour with far less salt and sugar than bottled sauce.

dishes.name: Chicken Egg Foo Young
dishes.concept: Fluffy omelettes packed with chicken, bean sprouts, mushrooms and scallion, pan-cooked in a little oil rather than deep-fried, with a light soy gravy, brown rice and garlicky broccoli. A lighter take on the takeaway favourite.

dishes.name: Chicken and Cabbage Okonomiyaki
dishes.concept: A savoury Japanese cabbage pancake with chicken and egg in a whole-wheat batter, topped with a light homemade tomato-soy sauce, a drizzle of yogurt mayo and seaweed flakes. Lighter than the original, with nonfat yogurt in place of mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Baked Chinese Lemon Chicken
dishes.concept: Crisp crumbed chicken strips baked rather than deep-fried, tossed in a fresh lemon-ginger sauce sweetened with just a little honey, served with stir-fried broccoli and pepper over brown rice. A lighter version of the restaurant classic.

dishes.name: Taiwanese Shredded Chicken Rice
dishes.concept: The Chiayi street-food classic: gently poached chicken shredded over rice, dressed with fragrant fried-shallot oil and a little soy, with blanched bok choy. Made with brown rice and a measured amount of oil, it stays light but full of flavour.

dishes.name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas
dishes.concept: Shredded chicken in a smoky chipotle-tomato sauce piled on oven-baked corn tostadas with refried-style pinto beans, crisp lettuce and a little queso fresco. Baking the tortillas instead of frying them keeps this Puebla favourite light.

dishes.name: Argentine Grilled Chicken with Chimichurri
dishes.nativeName: Pollo a la Parrilla con Chimichurri
dishes.concept: Skinless chicken thighs grilled hot and spooned with a sharp, fresh chimichurri of parsley, oregano, garlic and vinegar, with grilled zucchini, pepper and potato. A simple parrilla plate with a measured amount of olive oil.

dishes.name: Peruvian Chicken and Coriander Rice Soup
dishes.concept: A vivid green Peruvian soup of chicken, rice, potato, peas, corn and peppers, coloured and flavoured with a blended paste of fresh coriander, spinach, garlic and chili. Hearty, low in fat and finished with lime.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Yucatecan Chicken in Escabeche
dishes.concept: Chicken simmered with garlic, oregano and warm spices, then grilled and served in a light, tangy vinegar broth with plenty of softened onions and peppers, with corn tortillas and black beans. A classic of the Yucatán made with skinless chicken.
keyIngredients: chicken pieces, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Mexican Chicken with Zucchini and Corn
dishes.concept: A quick weeknight sauté of chicken, zucchini, sweet corn, tomato and green chili with cumin and oregano, finished with a little crumbled queso fresco and coriander and scooped up with warm corn tortillas.

dishes.name: Chilean Chicken and Corn Pie
dishes.concept: A Chilean family bake of spiced chicken and onion stew with olives and raisins under a golden crust of fresh sweet corn puréed with basil and milk. A lighter version made with chicken breast only and very little fat.

dishes.name: Northern Mexican Red Chile Chicken
dishes.concept: Tender chicken thighs simmered in a deep red sauce of rehydrated ancho chiles, garlic, onion and cumin, served with pinto beans and brown rice. Rich in flavour, with the chiles and beans adding plenty of fibre.

dishes.name: Persian Green Plum and Herb Stew with Chicken
dishes.concept: A tart spring khoresh of chicken braised with sour green plums and a heap of sautéed parsley, mint, coriander and fenugreek, lightly spiced with turmeric and served over fluffy basmati rice. Made with skinless thighs and a measured amount of oil.

dishes.name: Chicken, Labneh and Vegetable Breakfast Wrap
dishes.concept: Whole-wheat flatbread spread with labneh and za’atar, filled with shredded chicken, cucumber, tomato and mint. A five-minute, protein-rich breakfast that uses up leftover roast chicken.

dishes.name: Homemade Chicken and Sage Breakfast Patties
dishes.concept: Homemade patties of minced chicken, grated apple, sage and pepper, pan-browned and served with whole-grain toast, avocado and tomatoes. Half the mince is chopped breast, which keeps the saturated fat low, and the apple keeps them juicy with very little salt.

dishes.name: Chicken and Avocado Rye Toast with Egg
dishes.concept: Whole-grain rye toast with smashed avocado, sliced chicken, tomato and a poached egg. Rye bread and avocado bring plenty of fiber, and lemon and chili flakes season it without extra salt.

dishes.name: Baked Chicken Sambousek
dishes.concept: Small half-moon pastries of homemade whole-wheat dough filled with seven-spiced chicken, onion and parsley. Baking instead of deep-frying, and a filling of half chopped breast, make this a much lighter version of the mezze classic.

dishes.name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
dishes.concept: Minced chicken stir-fried with shiitake, carrot and crunchy celery in a ginger-hoisin glaze, spooned into crisp lettuce cups. Half the mince is chopped breast for a leaner filling, and a small amount of hoisin goes a long way.

dishes.name: Baked Chicken and Spinach Pakoras
dishes.concept: Bites of chicken, spinach and onion in a spiced chickpea-flour batter, baked on an oiled tray instead of deep-fried, with a cooling mint-yogurt chutney. Chickpea flour adds protein and fiber, and baking cuts most of the fat.

dishes.name: Japanese Three-Color Chicken Rice Bowl
dishes.concept: Brown rice topped with three stripes: ginger-soy minced chicken, soft scrambled egg and bright green beans. A quick, balanced bento classic, made leaner with half chopped breast in the mince and whole-grain rice.

dishes.name: Chinese Chicken and Sweetcorn Soup
dishes.concept: Silky chicken and sweetcorn soup with egg ribbons and ginger, made creamy by blending half the corn rather than using canned creamed corn. Edamame adds protein and fiber, and a scoop of brown rice on the side makes it a full meal.

dishes.name: Chicken Taco Salad
dishes.concept: Chili-lime chicken over romaine with black beans, charred corn, tomato, avocado and baked tortilla strips, tossed in a creamy yogurt-salsa dressing. Baking the tortilla strips and using nonfat yogurt in place of sour cream keep it light and filling.

dishes.name: Chicken Waldorf Salad
dishes.concept: Roast chicken, crisp apple, celery, grapes and toasted walnuts in a tangy yogurt dressing over romaine, with whole-grain bread. A lighter take on the classic, with nonfat Greek yogurt in place of mayonnaise.

dishes.name: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
dishes.concept: A hearty soup of chicken, nutty wild rice, mushrooms, carrot and celery in a thyme-scented broth, finished with milk thickened with a little flour in place of cream. Wild rice is a whole grain with plenty of fiber and protein.

dishes.name: Chicken Pot Pie with Filo Crust
dishes.concept: Chicken, peas, carrots and mushrooms in a creamy milk-thickened sauce under a crisp, crumpled filo top. Filo brushed with olive oil replaces buttery shortcrust and milk replaces cream, so it keeps all the comfort with a fraction of the saturated fat.

dishes.name: Oven-Fried Chicken with Slaw
dishes.concept: Skinless drumsticks marinated in garlicky yogurt, rolled in a smoky cornmeal and whole-wheat crumb coating and baked crisp, served with a crunchy yogurt slaw and corn on the cob. All the crunch of fried chicken with a fraction of the fat.
keyIngredients: chicken drumstick, skinless, bone-in (raw, weighed with bone)

dishes.name: Persian Dates and Eggs
dishes.concept: Dates warmed in the pan until soft and jammy, then eggs scrambled through with cinnamon and a few toasted walnuts, served with whole-wheat lavash. A lighter version of the Persian winter breakfast: a teaspoon of olive oil instead of butter, and the dates sweeten it with no added sugar.

dishes.name: Lebanese Zucchini and Eggs
dishes.concept: Diced zucchini and onion cooked slowly in olive oil until sweet, with garlic and eggs folded through and finished with dried mint, served with whole-wheat pita and tomato. A lighter version of the Lebanese village breakfast, made with a couple of teaspoons of olive oil instead of ghee and no added salt: the mint, garlic and pepper carry the flavour.

dishes.name: Tunisian Roasted Grain and Chickpea Porridge
dishes.concept: Barley and chickpea flour toasted with fennel and coriander, then stirred with soy milk, olive oil and chopped dates into a nutty, warming porridge. Whole-grain barley and chickpea give it about 10 g of fiber a bowl, and dates do the sweetening instead of sugar.

dishes.name: Sri Lankan Herbal Rice Porridge
dishes.concept: Red or brown rice and mung beans simmered soft, then stirred with a bright green purée of spinach, coriander, garlic and ginger and a spoon of coconut milk, served with a date on the side as Sri Lankans serve it with jaggery. Rice and mung beans make it a filling, high-fiber vegan bowl, and the coconut milk is kept to a measured spoon.

dishes.name: Korean Steamed Egg with Rice and Greens
dishes.concept: A soft, fluffy steamed egg custard with scallion, served with brown rice and sesame spinach namul. Steaming needs no fat at all, and whole-grain rice and a big bowl of greens round out a light, balanced Korean breakfast.

dishes.name: Mexican Eggs with Cactus
dishes.concept: Diced fresh cactus paddles sautéed with onion, tomato and jalapeño, then scrambled with eggs and served with warm corn tortillas and cumin-spiced pinto beans. Nopales and beans give about 14 g of fiber a plate, and low-sodium beans and a measured pinch of salt keep it light.

dishes.name: Brazilian Steamed Corn Couscous with Eggs
dishes.concept: Coarse whole-grain cornmeal moistened and steamed into a fluffy cake, the everyday breakfast of north-east Brazil, served with softly fried eggs and a fresh tomato, onion and coriander salsa. Steaming instead of frying and a teaspoon of oil for the eggs keep it light and naturally gluten-free.

dishes.name: Baked Oatmeal with Berries
dishes.concept: Rolled oats, milk, egg and mashed banana baked with berries and cinnamon into a soft, sliceable breakfast slab with a crunchy walnut top. The banana does all the sweetening, so there is no added sugar, and each square carries about 8 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Persian Green Bean Kuku
dishes.concept: Chopped green beans, onion and carrot cooked with turmeric and set with eggs into a thick golden kuku, served in wedges with whole-wheat lavash, a few walnuts and thick yogurt. A lighter version cooked with a single spoon of olive oil instead of shallow frying; the bread and yogurt balance the eggs.

dishes.name: Savory Polenta with Greens and Egg
dishes.concept: Creamy whole-grain polenta cooked in milk and water, topped with garlicky sautéed kale, a soft poached egg and a fine grating of parmesan. Cooking the polenta in water and milk rather than stock, and using just a little cheese, keeps the sodium low; whole-grain cornmeal and kale give about 7 g of fiber a bowl.

dishes.name: Mushrooms on Toast with Poached Egg
dishes.concept: Garlic and thyme mushrooms and wilted spinach piled on whole-wheat toast spread with lemony whipped cottage cheese, topped with a poached egg. Unsalted cottage cheese instead of butter adds protein with almost no salt, for about 30 g of protein a plate.
keyIngredients: cottage cheese, 1% fat, no salt added

dishes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea and Potato Breakfast Hash
dishes.concept: Crispy potato cubes, chickpeas, red pepper and onion browned with smoked paprika and cumin, with spinach wilted through and a tahini-lemon drizzle on top. A one-pan vegan breakfast with about 15 g of fiber a plate, using a single spoon of olive oil and low-sodium chickpeas.

dishes.name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Breakfast Tacos
dishes.concept: Warm corn tortillas filled with cumin-roasted sweet potato, black beans, sliced avocado and fresh pico de gallo. A filling vegan breakfast with about 19 g of fiber a plate, using low-sodium beans and a measured pinch of salt.

dishes.name: Turkish Fish Soup
dishes.concept: White fish, potato, carrot and celery in a lemony broth thickened with a little egg and flour, with whole-wheat bread. The Black Sea and Istanbul fish soup made light: one spoon of olive oil, measured salt and a lemon-egg terbiye instead of butter, for about 30 g of protein a bowl.

dishes.name: Gaza Sumac Stew with Beef and Chard
dishes.concept: Lean beef, chard and chickpeas in a tangy sumac and tahini sauce with dill and garlic, the festive Eid stew of Gaza. This lighter version uses lean stewing beef, a modest spoon of tahini and chickpeas cooked from dried, keeping the sodium low and the fiber high.

dishes.name: Aleppo Lamb Meatballs in Cherry Sauce
dishes.concept: Lean lamb meatballs simmered in a sour cherry sauce with toasted pine nuts, served over pita and bulgur, the celebrated dish of Aleppo. This lighter version uses minced lean lamb leg, a little pomegranate molasses instead of added sugar and whole-grain sides.

dishes.name: Thai Steamed Fish with Lime and Chili
dishes.concept: Fish steamed and dressed with a sharp lime, garlic and chili sauce made with a little fish sauce, with brown rice and garlicky bok choy. Steaming keeps it fat-free and the bright dressing means very little salt is needed.

dishes.name: Italian Salmon with Lentils
dishes.concept: Pan-roasted salmon over Umbrian-style lentils slowly cooked with carrot, celery, onion and rosemary. Oily fish and a big bowl of lentils make it rich in omega-3 fats, protein and fiber, with a single spoon of olive oil.

dishes.name: Aegean Sardines Grilled in Vine Leaves
dishes.concept: Fresh sardines wrapped in vine leaves and grilled, served with a tomato bulgur pilaf and a tomato-onion salad, as along the Aegean coast in spring. The leaves keep the fish moist with no frying, and sardines are one of the richest sources of omega-3 fats.

dishes.name: Taiwanese Beef Noodle Soup
dishes.concept: Lean beef braised with star anise, ginger, tomato and chili bean paste into a deep, spiced broth, ladled over noodles with bok choy. A lighter take on the Taipei classic: lean stewing beef, a measured spoon of reduced-sodium soy sauce and plenty of greens.

dishes.name: Persian Eggplant, Lentil and Lamb Halim
dishes.concept: Roasted eggplant, lentils and a little lean lamb cooked down into a thick, savory mash topped with yogurt, mint oil and golden onions. Nonfat yogurt in place of the usual kashk and onions cooked in a measured spoon of oil rather than deep-fried make this a lighter, fiber-rich version.

dishes.name: Turkish Poached Lamb with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Lean lamb shank meat simmered slowly with potato, carrot, celery, onion and chickpeas, the clear broth finished with lemon and served with bread. A light, comforting Anatolian pot: the meat is trimmed and the fat skimmed, so all the flavour comes from slow cooking.
keyIngredients: lamb shank meat, lean (raw, off the bone)

dishes.name: Lighter Shepherd’s Pie
dishes.concept: Lean minced lamb stretched with green lentils, carrot and peas under a mash of potato and cauliflower, baked until golden. Lean leg mince, lentils for fiber and a lighter cauliflower mash made with skim milk and olive oil instead of butter keep this family classic well within the healthy range.

dishes.name: Moroccan Fish Tagine with Chermoula
dishes.concept: Fish marinated in a coriander, garlic and cumin chermoula and baked on a bed of potatoes, peppers and tomatoes. A one-dish Moroccan supper where the herb marinade does the seasoning, with just a couple of spoons of olive oil.

dishes.name: Omani Grilled Kingfish with Lemon Rice
dishes.concept: Kingfish rubbed with turmeric, cumin and lemon and grilled, served with lemon-scented rice and a crunchy tomato, onion, carrot and lettuce salad, as on the Omani coast. Grilling rather than frying keeps it light, and the generous salad adds fiber.

dishes.name: Turkey, Barley and Vegetable Soup
dishes.concept: Lean turkey breast simmered with pearl barley, carrot, celery, kale and thyme into a hearty, chunky soup. Low in fat and high in fiber and protein, it is a whole meal in a bowl that keeps well all week.

dishes.name: Jordanian Lentil, Bulgur and Yogurt Soup
dishes.concept: A thick Jordanian winter soup of lentils, chickpeas and coarse bulgur simmered together and finished with a garlicky yogurt sauce standing in for jameed, with onions softened in olive oil and a dusting of dried mint. Low-fat yogurt in place of the salty dried jameed keeps sodium low while the legumes and whole grain give over 20 g of protein and plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Afghan Eggplant with Garlic Yogurt
dishes.concept: Afghan eggplant slices simmered in a turmeric and coriander tomato sauce, spooned over cool garlic and mint yogurt, with chickpeas and warm whole-wheat naan. A lighter version: the eggplant is roasted with a brush of olive oil instead of fried, the sauce uses fresh tomatoes, and nonfat yogurt keeps saturated fat low.

dishes.name: Korean Braised Tofu
dishes.concept: Slices of firm tofu pan-browned, then braised in a garlicky gochugaru and soy sauce with scallion until glazed, served with brown rice and sesame-seasoned spinach. Reduced-sodium soy sauce and a spoon of oil keep it light, and the plate gives over 30 g of protein.

dishes.name: Sicilian Pasta alla Norma
dishes.concept: The Catania classic of pasta tossed with soft eggplant in a garlic and basil tomato sauce, topped with ricotta. This lighter version roasts the eggplant with a measured spoon of olive oil instead of frying it, uses whole-wheat pasta and adds white beans, for about 20 g of protein and well over 15 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Mushroom and Barley Orzotto
dishes.concept: The northern Italian answer to risotto: pearl barley stirred slowly with browned mushrooms, onion and thyme until creamy, finished with peas, lemon and a little parmesan. Barley brings a nutty chew and far more fiber than rice, and only a little broth and cheese keep the sodium modest.

dishes.name: Persian Tomato Rice with Potatoes and Split Peas
dishes.concept: A homely Persian one-pot of basmati rice cooked in a turmeric-tomato base with potato cubes and yellow split peas, finished with a crisp tahdig from a single spoon of oil and served with a fresh salad Shirazi. The split peas make it a filling vegan plate with plenty of fiber.

dishes.name: Persian Onion, Fenugreek and Egg Soup
dishes.concept: A frugal Persian soup of onions cooked slowly with turmeric and dried fenugreek leaves, simmered with potato and chickpeas and finished with eggs poached right in the pot, eaten with whole-wheat bread. Chickpeas join the eggs and bread for a satisfying bowl with a measured spoon of oil and little salt.

dishes.name: Lebanese Potato Kibbeh with Herbs
dishes.concept: The Lenten kibbeh of Lebanon: mashed potato and fine bulgur kneaded with grated onion, dried mint and warm spices, layered in a tray around a filling of spinach, onion, chickpeas and sumac, and baked with a brush of olive oil instead of frying. Served with a chopped salad, it is a whole-grain vegan main with about 20 g of fiber.

dishes.name: Lighter Eggplant Parmigiana
dishes.concept: Layers of oven-roasted eggplant, fresh tomato and basil sauce, part-skim mozzarella and a little parmesan, baked until bubbling and served with garlicky white beans. In this lighter version the eggplant is roasted rather than fried, the sauce is made from fresh tomatoes, and the cheese is kept modest so sodium and saturated fat stay in range, while the beans add protein and fiber.

dishes.name: Bean Enchiladas in Red Sauce
dishes.concept: Corn tortillas rolled around pinto beans and wilted spinach, baked under a smoky ancho chile and tomato sauce and finished with a scattering of queso fresco. A lighter version: the tortillas are warmed in the oven instead of dipped in hot oil, the beans are low-sodium, and the cheese is just a crumble, for nearly 20 g of fiber a plate.

dishes.name: Fresh Fava Beans with Garlic and Coriander
dishes.concept: Green fava beans sautéed with garlic and fresh coriander in a little olive oil and brightened with lemon, a Lebanese spring mezze. Naturally lean, with a good amount of plant protein and fiber for a snack.

dishes.name: Greek Yellow Split Pea Purée
dishes.concept: The silky yellow split pea purée of Santorini, simmered with onion and bay and whipped with lemon, topped with red onion, a few capers and a thread of olive oil, with cucumber and carrot for scooping. Rich in plant protein and fiber, it makes a filling vegan snack.

dishes.name: Andalusian Gazpacho
dishes.concept: The chilled Andalusian soup of ripe tomato, cucumber, green pepper and garlic blended with a little whole-wheat bread, olive oil and apple cider vinegar. A light, no-cook glass of vegetables for hot afternoons, made with less oil and salt than usual.

dishes.name: Turkish Roasted Peppers with Garlic Yogurt
dishes.concept: Charred red and green peppers, peeled and dressed with garlic yogurt, a thread of olive oil and a pinch of pul biber. A classic Turkish meze that is smoky, cool and light, made with nonfat yogurt.

dishes.name: Yemeni Yogurt and Bread Salad
dishes.concept: Thin bread soaked in a spiced, herby yogurt that is thinned to buttermilk, topped with tomato, cucumber and coriander. A cooling Yemeni dish served through Ramadan; this version uses nonfat Greek yogurt for extra protein.

dishes.name: Lighter Carrot Halwa
dishes.concept: Grated carrots slowly cooked down in 1% milk with cardamom, a little sugar, raisins and a few pistachios. A lighter take on the North Indian winter sweet, made without khoya and with only a teaspoon of ghee.

dishes.name: Baked Spinach and Pea Patties
dishes.concept: Bright green patties of spinach, peas and potato bound with toasted chickpea flour and warm spices, baked rather than deep-fried and served with a fresh mint and coriander chutney.

dishes.name: Japanese Agar Fruit Jelly
dishes.concept: Clear, lightly sweetened agar jelly set around fresh strawberries, kiwi and orange. A plant-based Japanese set dessert that is refreshing, low in fat and mostly fruit.

dishes.name: Korean Pumpkin Porridge
dishes.concept: Sweet pumpkin simmered until soft, blended smooth and thickened with a little rice flour, with tender red beans stirred through. A gently sweet, comforting Korean porridge that is naturally dairy-free.

dishes.name: Turkish Celeriac in Olive Oil with Orange
dishes.concept: Celeriac braised with carrot, potato and onion in olive oil and fresh orange juice, then served cool with dill. A classic Turkish olive-oil meze that is bright, mildly sweet and full of vegetables.

dishes.name: Mexican Cactus Salad
dishes.concept: Grilled fresh nopales with charred corn, tomato, onion, jalapeño and coriander, dressed with lime and finished with a little crumbled queso fresco. Grilling keeps the cactus crisp and fresh-tasting.

dishes.name: Peruvian Bean and Cheese Salad
dishes.concept: A bright salad from Arequipa of tender fava beans, sweet corn, tomato, red onion, olives and chili with a little queso fresco, all dressed in lime and olive oil.

dishes.name: Watermelon, Feta and Mint Salad
dishes.concept: Chilled watermelon with crisp cucumber, red onion, mint, lime and just a little crumbled feta. A sweet, salty and refreshing summer snack that is mostly fruit.

dishes.name: White Bean and Rosemary Dip with Vegetables
dishes.concept: Creamy cannellini beans blended with lemon, garlic, rosemary and olive oil, served with crunchy carrot, cucumber and pepper sticks. A no-cook, fiber-rich dip ready in 15 minutes.

dishes.name: Iraqi Baked Lentil Sambusa
dishes.concept: Crisp filo triangles filled with red lentils, golden onion, cumin and parsley, a favourite on the Iraqi Ramadan table. Baked with a light brush of olive oil instead of deep-fried.

dishes.name: Baalbek Open Meat Pies
dishes.concept: Small square whole-wheat pies with a thin topping of lean minced beef, tomato, onion, seven spice and tangy pomegranate molasses, baked hot and fast. Two pies make a high-protein snack.
